This is a key thesis of mine:  wallets that can build a strong, differentiated brand on top of a clear value prop (e.g. best security, total privacy, cypherpunk, meme trading, etc.) should win big. 

Users will do more in the wallet, they will trust the wallet provider to ensure greater security, reasonable fees, and align in-app, curated partner options with community values. 

If @ambire, for example, add prediction markets directly within their app, they will not likely use @Polymarket, but @Trueo_. Why?  Trueo is better aligned with their cypherpunk values, and what their users probably want (note: this is just my opinion, man, I'm not part of the Ambire team).

Just after DeFi Summer, Metamask was doing over $200 million in annual revenue!  Those fee volumes are going to come back, eventually, as crypto grows. However, in the coming wave, I believe it will be a handful of wallet apps that capture that value, not just one (although Metamask will likely remain a major player).  Wallets that can break out now and build their brand will be cash generators.

I wrote about Ambire Wallet here: https://t.co/DkeekSC7GX

Am I wrong?  I'd love to hear counterarguments!

quoted_text:
Through my wonderful time at NVIDIA and Stanford, one question has kept me up at night: 

Should the future of AI be monolithic or plural?

To answer this question, we’ve raised $110M to get started, backed by @MenloVentures, @MadronaVentures, @NVIDIA, @NEA, @KindredVentures,@Wing_VC, @aixventureshq, @Principal_VC, @Cisco, @Snowflake, among others.

Today, Carlos (@guestrin) and I are stoked to launch Noeri, a neolab to push the frontier of plural intelligence.

Noeri means “the plural of intelligence” or many intelligences. 

The future of AI we root for is plural: a healthy ecosystem of many intelligences, in all sizes, strengths, and quirks. 

Discovery, in particular, has always been plural: many curious minds, each devoted to their own question, often on roads less traveled.

Our path there is self-improving AI that:

-> learns continually on the job, closing the gap between what AI can do off the shelf and what the dynamic world demands

-> learns to use other AIs as tools and make new tools to overcome its own limitations

-> picks the right-sized model for your problem, at a fraction of the frontier cost

Then the power of intelligence, from the craftsmanship of making AI to ownership, can be in the hands of all.

@noeri_ai mission reflects who we are as the founding team. My career has been anything but linear, literally continual learning on the job. Carlos has devoted his career to building tools that empower people through AI. 

We are all a bit contrarian, a bit adventurous, and above all, big believers in pluralism.

Join us to build this future together: https://t.co/oAAoe0lzEH

text:
我有很强烈的感觉，币圈下一个爆发的赛道是 TCG 卡牌上链

上个周期爆发的赛道是预测市场 & 代币化股票，代币化股票属于 RWA，RWA 的意思就是把现实世界的资产搬到链上来交易。

这两年的 RWA 项目很多，有人尝试把房地产搬到链上来交易，有人尝试把红酒搬到链上来交易，但玩到最后我们会发现，这些方向其实都很鸡肋，有点脱裤子放屁的感觉。

因为不是每种资产都适合搬到链上来交易的。

RWA 目前已经成功的案例有稳定币、代币化美股和债券等等这几个，它们都有几个共同的特性：

• 现实世界中本来就存在大量的交易需求。
• 资产足够标准化，这一份和那一份没有区别。
• 鉴定 & 确权的成本足够低。
• 传统交易方式有局限性，而上链恰好解决了这些局限。

我觉得 TCG 卡牌刚好具备这 4 个特性。

TCG 卡牌尤其是宝可梦系列，本来就存在大量的交易需求，体量至少比目前的 NFT 市场要大得多。

而且 TCG 卡牌的价值共识是经过时间历练的，光是宝可梦系列的 TCG 卡牌就有 30 多年的历史，比特币也就 17 年。论共识，TCG 卡牌可能还是比不过比特币，但是要是拿去跟一些山寨币比，或者跟一些 NFT 小图片比，那完全是绰绰有余的。

再来就是，TCG 卡牌本身有很完善的评级体系。一张卡牌经过 PSA 这样的评级公司鉴定之后，就可以实现资产的标准化，也就是说，两张同样的卡牌，只要都被评为 PSA 10，那「这一张」和「那一张」就没有本质区别，市场也会给予它们同样的定价。

最重要的是，TCG 卡牌的传统交易方式是真的很麻烦，流动性也很差，大部分人都是在线下面对面交易，有一部分人是通过闲鱼或 eBay 这种线上二手平台交易，又慢又麻烦，有些平台甚至还要抽手续费。

所以，币圈去做「TCG 卡牌上链 + 交易平台」这件事情，

其实会是两个圈子双向奔赴的事情。

TCG 圈子需要币圈进来，解决流动性和交易便利性的问题。币圈也迫切需要 TCG 卡牌这种经过时间历练、交易体量足够大的圈子，来进一步去推动 Crypto 的 Mass Adoption。

双向奔赴的好处是，币圈去做这件事不会是一个人在唱独角戏，这个飞轮一旦转起来了，两个圈子的人都会一起积极去推动它前进。我们回看以前的很多的 RWA 项目，其实很多都是币圈在单方面唱独角戏，传统行业的人根本懒得管你币圈在干什么东西。

目前在做 TCG 这个赛道的项目很多，比较主流的有：

BNBChain 上的 @renaissxyz
Solana 上的 @Collector_Crypt 和 @phygitals
Polygon 上的 @Courtyard_io

我自己个人比较看好 Renaiss，

@yzilabs 已经投了他们，我觉得 Renaiss 应该是继 @Aster_DEX 和 @predictdotfun 之后，下一个有机会直接接入币安体系的基础设施，光是这一点，Renaiss 的想象空间就很大了。

如果你也玩 TCG 卡牌的话、可以看看 Renaiss 这个项目，了解一下，可以开几个包玩一玩，也可以当作是一个流动性更好的买卖卡渠道，他们还没发币，顺便做个交互，可以博个空投预期。

• 可以走我的邀请链接：https://t.co/66JwwR9K0s

text:
Anthropic was $1.66T on Entropy and $1.25T on Binance this morning. Same company, same hour, ~$400B apart, two days before its IPO.

Almost all of that gap is the contract spec.

Entropy converts at listing on fully diluted shares, ~18B including options and RSUs. 1,660 = ~$92 a share.

Binance quoted on a 1B placeholder. Today it resized to ~13.1B shares outstanding. Same positions, new price: ~$95.

trade[.]xyz trades one Class A share: $95.

Per share, three venues sit within ~4% of each other, but the real bet is the day-one pop. ~$92–96 against a $78 top of range is +18–23%. The book is reportedly ~6x oversubscribed.

If you trade this, read the conversion rule before the price. A $400B spread between headlines is mostly a denominator.

Also, follow the liquidity. Entropy holds ~$198M of open interest. Binance and trade[.]xyz hold ~$115M each.

SpaceX perps traded near $176 into a $135 IPO. Once shares traded, they matched the stock within the hour, and a week later they sat within 2% of it.

A price is only as good as its definition and always has to be contextualized with the market setup. True for pre-IPO perps, true for every RWA feed we build.

quoted_text:
I salute @jrfarr and the Lemon Squeezy (LS) team for all their, continued, contributions to our ecosystem 🫡

First, LS helped define a category, empower entrepreneurs in the digital realm, and build a product and brand that spread joy, optimism and sparks of ambition - much like real lemonade stands (impeccable brand narrative).

Second, they went on to make the core value - Merchant of Record (MoR) - tablestake as it should be in our ecosystem via Stripe Managed Payments.

Third, their team has clearly contributed a lot to Stripe too through numerous other contributions, and I can’t wait to see what’s next for them to propel the ecosystem forward. 

Forth, we’ve received a lot of support messages from people wanting to migrate to @polar_sh, and as a testament to how much LS cares about the entrepreneurs they’ve supported, we’re now working together on how to make that transition seamless before the deadline for those who prefer going with Polar.

Affected merchants now deserve the best solution for their business and one they feel confident with for years to come. You’ll be chased by countless platforms now promising rainbows to optimize short-term growth. Don’t stress: Take your time to test & choose wisely based on your unique business and its needs - you have 4 months to migrate.

I prefer to be clear on what our vision is and ensure our team remains laser focused on it. Otherwise, it’s inevitably only going to cause us both pain in the long-term. If it’s a fit, great - we’re all in. If not, happy to help guide anyone in the right direction for their business.

Our focus is on the next generation of businesses building LLM-powered applications and services. We believe that will be all software over the span of the next decade, and that it imposes unique challenges that the status quo of billing is failing. More here: https://t.co/uIfr0ZW1A2

We also help automate entitlements and even fulfillment of common ones in the digital realm, e.g Slack/Discord invites for premium support, license keys for binaries, GitHub repositories, and files. 

So we’re great for businesses who also sell such assets. But the emphasis is on businesses that are in it for the long-term and aiming to iterate on their business & product for years to come. 

We’ll go super deep to innovate on billing for them, and will be launching Polar Payments in 2027 to go even deeper than we are today with MoR being optional.

We’re not going wide which is often what creators need. E.g built-in newsletters, affiliates, storefronts etc. We believe there are best-in-class solutions for those that you prefer to integrate Polar with. 

One is not better than the other, but they are different with often opposing needs. So I want to be clear what you can expect from us in the years to come.

Otherwise, there is Gumroad, Whop and plenty of others that cater better to creators needing a wider set of features all-in-one.

So take your time, and choose accordingly based on your needs and ambitions ahead.

I’m here to help regardless. Feel free to reach out over DMs or in the comments; I’ll be sure to reply to everyone, and help with migrations or give my 2c on better platforms for your specific needs.

I wish you all continued success and finding a great new home for your businesses! 🚀

text:
If you're looking at Nvidia and asking "Do I BUY, or is it going to DUMP more?"

Here's your simple guide before tonight's earnings.

What happened:

1. $NVDA has fallen 6 weeks in a row, its longest losing streak since 2012
2. -$2 trillion in value is gone since Oct peak
3. Its CEO of 33 years, Jensen Huang, just quit
4. Its valuation is now the lowest since 2012

So, is Nvidia a buy?

Let's keep it simple.

Right now, you pay ~$12 for every $1 of profit Nvidia is expected to make next year.

For the average big US stock, you pay ~$18.

So Nvidia looks ~33% cheaper than the average stock.

And business is still booming.

Last quarter, Nvidia made $96 billion in sales, more than double the year before.

So why is it so cheap?

Because investors are scared the AI boom will slow down.

If it does, Nvidia makes less money, and the stock isn't so cheap after all.

There's also a bigger risk.

Nvidia has promised to buy $279 billion worth of parts from suppliers.

If AI demand slows, it still has to pay for them.

That's why tonight matters.

Nvidia reports earnings after the US market closes.

Here's what to watch:

1. Sales this quarter
Expected: ~$109B (Higher = good, Lower = bad)

2. Sales forecast for next quarter (the most important)
Expected: ~$125B (Higher = the AI boom is still going,
Lower = the AI boom may be slowing)

3. Profit margin
Expected: ~74% (Higher = Nvidia is still making big money on every chip,
Lower = costs are eating into profits)

4. What interim CEO Colette Kress says about leadership

Our take:  Nobody knows if Nvidia has hit the bottom.

But "cheap" only matters if the AI boom keeps going.

Don't let fear or hype decide for you.

美国出口管制再升级：芯片不进中国不够了，连海外数据中心提供算力也要审批

此前马来西亚调查 AI 芯片转口、新加坡起诉涉案人员，如今美国直接把监管范围延伸到了海外数据中心的算力服务。

美国商务部公布新规，拟对全球数据中心向中国等受限地区企业提供大规模先进 AI 算力设置许可要求。即使 GPU 部署在新加坡、马来西亚等第三国，只要最终为受限企业提供达到门槛的算力，也可能需要获得美国批准。

与此同时，新加坡、马来西亚、印尼、泰国和巴西的先进芯片出口也将面临新增许可要求，存量数据中心同样需要在过渡期内申请许可。

这意味着，美国正在逐步堵上两条路径：一是先进芯片通过第三国转口，二是中国企业通过海外云服务远程租用 GPU。

监管对象正在从芯片的物理流向，延伸到算力的最终使用者。过去关注的是芯片卖给谁、运到哪里；现在美国还要追问，这些芯片最终在为谁提供计算能力。

对于新加坡、马来西亚等东南亚数据中心枢纽，以及依赖海外 GPU 的中国 AI 企业而言，这都意味着更复杂的合规环境。全球 AI 算力供应链的边界，正在被重新划定。

quoted_text:
开始动手了！美国开始堵截东南亚 AI 算力转口通道。

11 月 13 日，马来西亚与新加坡几乎同步采取行动，东南亚正在成为美国芯片出口管制的新监管前线。

- 马来西亚启动调查： 投资、贸易及工业部联合海关，核查数据中心租户 Speedmatrix 自带服务器和 AI 芯片入驻机房，是否涉及违规转出口。

- 新加坡起诉第五名嫌疑人： 涉及向马来西亚转口、内含英伟达高端芯片服务器的贸易欺诈案，已有第五名涉案人员被起诉。

- 美国国会加大施压： 商务部长卢特尼克收到 12 月 10 日出席参议院听证会的邀请，黄仁勋则被邀请于 12 月 3 日出席。

- OpenAI 转向支持更严格管制： 据彭博社报道，OpenAI 已向国会表达支持进一步限制中国获取先进 AI 芯片及半导体制造设备的立场。相关提案还涉及芯片追踪和海外 GPU 远程访问。

与此同时，中芯国际 2026 年第三季度中国区营收占比升至 90.8%，产能利用率达到 97.3%，本土晶圆代工需求持续增长。

这背后的变化值得警惕：

过去，美国主要通过出口许可证控制先进芯片流向；现在，监管范围正在向第三国转口、数据中心部署，甚至海外 GPU 算力租赁延伸。这意味着，即使芯片没有进入中国境内，中国企业通过新加坡、马来西亚等地租用海外 GPU，也可能面临更严格的审查。

黄仁勋过去一直试图在美国国家安全政策与英伟达全球商业利益之间寻找平衡。如今，越来越多 AI 企业开始支持收紧出口限制，华盛顿对先进算力的监管也正在从芯片贸易延伸至算力使用。

美国要控制的可能不再只是显卡卖给谁，而是谁有权使用这些显卡。对于中国 AI 产业而言，国产 GPU、国产云计算和本土算力基础设施的替代价值，正在进一步上升。

注：马来西亚目前仍处于调查阶段；卢特尼克收到的是听证会邀请，并非已确认出席；相关出口限制法案也尚未全部通过。

text:
🎤主題：Solana 告別 mainnet beta，邁向 mainnet 1.0 — Lily Liu、Rachel Conlan

講者
Lily Liu，Solana Foundation 總裁 ＋ Rachel Conlan，Solana Foundation 策略長

重點整理
Lily Liu：mainnet 1.0 宣告
1. 六年來大家說的都是 mainnet beta。今天 Solana 正式告別 beta，從 mainnet beta 邁向 mainnet 1.0。現場播了一支短片慶祝。

2. 1.0 的意義：這是對 Solana 網路過去一年成果與核心協議改變的認可。

3. 區塊變快：區塊時間從 400 毫秒降到 200 毫秒，網路記錄新活動的頻率翻倍，等待時間減半。

4. 區塊變大：每個區塊能裝的量超過三倍，複雜的金融操作以前要拆開做，現在一次就能完成。

5. 租金降 10 倍：持有資產的成本降了 10 倍，對代幣化很重要，公司可以為幾百萬客戶負擔這筆成本而不覺得痛。

6. 終局性 150 毫秒：Alpenglow 上線幾週後，交易終局性從約 13 秒降到 150 毫秒，約 85 倍的提升，全天候在真實網路上跑。

Rachel Conlan：2026 年的三件事
1. 資本來了：上一季超過 70 億美元的代幣化股票在 Solana 上交易。真實世界資產創紀錄的 50 億美元，6 月以來增加 30 億，超過 100 萬人持有。質押 ETF 40 億美元，幾乎是 6 月的兩倍。bSOL 上線不到 10 個月就突破 10 億美元。摩根士丹利 7 月推出了自己的 ETF。

2. Builder 把華爾街搬上鏈：Backpack 把美國股票變成代幣，每個代幣背後都有真實股票。Sunrise 從第一天就給這些代幣深厚的流動性，每週交易 10 億美元。SpaceX 在 NASDAQ 掛牌同一天，代幣化版本也在 Solana 上線。

3. 收入是真的：第一季 Solana 上的應用賺了 3.7 億美元，三個月內成長 48%。連續 10 個季度，Solana 在應用收入上領先所有鏈。超過 60 個應用年收入超過 100 萬美元。每天有 220 萬個活躍錢包。

4. 網路撐住了：8 月 21 日高峰日，網路處理超過 2.17 億筆真實交易。8 月有 29% 的質押退出，區塊照樣出。10 月 21 日 Alpenglow 上線，終局性從近 13 秒降到約 150 毫秒，區塊時間降到 200 毫秒。

Lily Liu：未來，Token Supercycle
1. 主題是結構轉變。錢、資產、所有權都在上鏈，搬上全天候的網路基礎設施，而且回不去了。價格週期不是重點。

2. 四股力量匯合：穩定幣在全球規模上移動資金。機構把傳統資產搬上鏈，也就是 RWA、代幣化。基礎設施終於夠快、夠便宜、夠有效率，可以承載真實經濟活動。AI 把軟體變成經濟行為者，需要可程式化的錢，AI 沒有信用卡。Solana 承載了近四分之三的 x402 agent payments。

3. 穩定幣的規模：Solana 上的穩定幣供應三年內成長超過 10 倍。過去一年穩定幣交易量接近 5 兆美元，2 月單月 6,500 億美元，是任何鏈上最大的單月。全球最大的支付公司都在 Solana 上建設：Western Union、Visa、MoneyGram。三星把 Solana USDC 整合進 8,200 萬個錢包，先從美國開始。

4. 分銷就是估值：同一塊錢的利潤，值多少取決於在哪裡買得到。同一家公司在倫敦上市，比在紐約上市便宜 25–30%。有兩個關口：掛在哪裡，以及能不能進指數（S&P 500、FTSE 100、MSCI）。全球約 22,000 家公司在美國以外上市，只有 5% 進得了 2 兆美元以上資金追蹤的指數。掛錯交易所或沒進指數，公司實際上就隱形了。代幣化擴大接觸面與分銷，讓每個資產從任何地方都同樣能被發現、被取得。Solana 讓金融變平。

5. 從基本收入到基本所有權：AI 的代幣讓人問起人類能動性，有人認為全民基本收入不可避免。Lily 認為那是悲觀的看法，等於說只能用權利取代人的能動性。區塊鏈的看法相反：任何人都能參與經濟創造，關鍵是所有權。願景是全民基本所有權。全民基本收入不在願景裡。達成的方式是大家已經在用的應用。金融現在只差一次 API 呼叫。Solana 要成為金融的開放 API、資本主義的開放 API。現場樓下就有這些應用：Phantom、FOMO、World 等。金融變成 API 後，每個應用都能變成超級應用。

6. 結尾：金融的大門第一次不再由地理、營業時間或認識誰來決定。目標是讓金融開放、全天候、隨時可及，散戶與機構用同樣的流動性。Lily 請 Amira 上台，帶大家看未來兩天資產所有權的導覽。

關鍵數字
• mainnet beta 告別，邁向 mainnet 1.0；區塊 400 毫秒降到 200 毫秒；終局性約 13 秒降到 150 毫秒，約 85 倍；租金降 10 倍

• 代幣化股票上一季超過 70 億美元；真實世界資產 50 億美元，6 月以來增加 30 億，超過 100 萬人持有；質押 ETF 40 億美元；bSOL 不到 10 個月突破 10 億美元

• 第一季應用收入 3.7 億美元，三個月內成長 48%；連續 10 個季度領先所有鏈；60 多個應用年收入超過 100 萬美元；每天 220 萬個活躍錢包

• 8 月 21 日高峰日超過 2.17 億筆真實交易；8 月 29% 質押退出，區塊照樣出

• 穩定幣交易量過去一年接近 5 兆美元；2 月單月 6,500 億美元；穩定幣供應三年內成長超過 10 倍；三星整合 Solana USDC 進 8,200 萬個錢包

• 全球約 22,000 家公司在美國以外上市，只有 5% 進得了 2 兆美元以上資金追蹤的指數；倫敦上市比紐約便宜 25–30%

黑柴怎麼看
這段演講的新聞是 mainnet 1.0。
六年 beta 終於結束，數字很具體：
區塊 200 毫秒、終局性 150 毫秒、租金降 10 倍。Rachel 的三件事把 2026 年講清楚了。資本方面，代幣化股票 70 億美元、真實世界資產 50 億美元。

收入方面，應用一季賺 3.7 億美元。擴容方面，高峰日 2.17 億筆。Lily 後半段的「分銷就是估值」是全場最實在的論點，倫敦上市比紐約便宜 25–30%，代幣化要解決的就是這個地理問題。

「全民基本所有權」是願景，建議聽的時候分開看，願景和承諾不一樣。XD

text:
🇺🇸 Is America about to have a TOTAL BLACKOUT?

A Simpsons episode. Grounded flights. Microsoft disruption. Banking delays.

These events are being stitched together into a warning about November 17.

There is no verified evidence of an approaching nationwide blackout.

But here’s why the story has found an audience.

1998:
The Simpsons shows a Fox sign reading “A Division of Walt Disney Co.”

In 2019, Disney completes its acquisition of much of 21st Century Fox.

2000:
Lisa Simpson refers to inheriting the presidency from “President Trump.”

Sixteen years later, Trump wins the election.

2023:
The show depicts a six-day blackout in Springfield, with November 17 referenced in the episode.

Now that clip is circulating as a prediction for TODAY.

Except the episode never identifies 2026. Its blackout ends on Thanksgiving, which falls on November 26 this year. The timeline does not fit.

Then came this week.

NOVEMBER 12:

Microsoft services suffer a major outage.

NOVEMBER 13:

The FAA orders a nationwide ground stop after its telecommunications network becomes unstable.

17 of 22 en-route control centres experience instability.

About 12,462 flights are cancelled that Friday, although the FAA says not all cancellations were caused by the ground stop.

NOVEMBER 16:

A software bug at Chase delays transactions, including some involving other banks. Chase says it was not cyber-related.

NOVEMBER 17:

A nationwide emergency-alert test is scheduled for 2:20 PM Eastern.

A test message on television and radio. No announced shutdown of the electricity grid.

The cartoon does not establish a threat. Neither does putting unrelated outages beside one another.

What the documented failures do show is how quickly technical problems can interrupt commerce.

Flights stop. Transfers slow. Businesses lose access to essential software.

An economy can suffer disruption long before the lights go out.

text:
在老黄出事前1个月就减持60% $NVDA 仓位，投资大佬段永平真的能未卜先知？

昨晚段永平的 13F 报告一出来，大家都怀疑他提前拿到内幕精准逃顶，毕竟时间线看着太玄乎了。

报告显示，Q3 单季他砍掉 63% 英伟达仓位，三个季度累计减持近七成；紧接着一个多月后，老黄突发辞职，英伟达应声暴跌超 31%。

但如果把持仓报告和他平时在雪球透露的操作策略拼在一起看，其实更像是贯彻了绝对的交易纪律，并没有啥开天眼的操作。

今年 Q1 AI 情绪最热时，段永平曾一路加仓到 1384 万股，把它买成了第三大持仓；但从 Q2 股价继续冲高开始，他就已经开始一直在往外撤了。

你说他完全预见到了老黄会出事那是不可能的；但之所以能撤得这么巧，，是因为他一直在高位卖英伟达的看涨期权（Covered Call）。

股价涨破行权价后，手里的股票被买家自动行权交割了出去，本质上是他觉得 NVDA 短期涨幅透支了基本面，按纪律收下权利金、主动让渡筹码锁定利润，而不是去赌最后一个铜板。

同时，更能说明问题的一点是老黄出事之后的操作。

英伟达暴跌超 31% 之后，段永平不仅没把剩下的 3% 仓位清光，反而在市场最恐慌、期权费暴涨的时候，悄悄开始卖出看跌期权（Sell Put），准备在更低的安全边际把筹码接回来。

他在雪球上也说：“我觉得我买 NVDA 的大部分理由都还在，只是黄不在了。价格上已经都体现出来了，我会很有兴趣看看这个公司能不能走出危机，所以不想急着逃。”

所以看上去的未卜先知，拆开看真的就是很朴素的交易纪律：Q1顺势重仓，Q2+Q3在狂热中被动交割落袋，暴跌后在恐慌里伸手接盘。

顺带一提，13F 里显示，Q3段永平减持的不止英伟达。

谷歌被减持了 41.5%，苹果被减持了 21.76%，微软也小幅减持，甚至清仓了阿里巴巴和稳定币巨头 Circle（CRCL）。

那这笔从狂热科技股里套出来的庞大现金，流向了哪里？

答案是拼多多和特斯拉。

Q3他大幅增持了近 297 万股拼多多，持仓占比拉升到 12.69%，跃居整个组合的第三大重仓；特斯拉被加仓近 70 万股，仓位占比提到 8.42%

一个是现金流极其强悍的下沉消费龙头，另一个是在机器人与航天领域手握排他性壁垒的马斯克体系。

哪有那么多通天神眼，有的只是对纪律常识的绝对遵从。

Most AI research tools just tell you what you want to hear, which is a problem when you’re actually making decisions based on the answer.

Crux uses SERV to stress-test its own answers, sends the report off to independent @reppo reviewers, and then goes back and rewrites it based on their critiques. In one run it nearly doubled the facts it found and lowered its own confidence because the reviewers turned out to be right.

@myacxt built the first version in our first hackathon and came back with this, love to see it.

text:
Great practical paper on speeding up agent evals and RL rollouts.

For agent batches, they suggest running the longest trajectories first, because they determine when the whole batch finishes.

Agent tasks alternate between model inference and environment steps, so GPUs and sandboxes wait on each other. The Ling team schedules both together. Trajectories stay on the workers that hold their KV cache, and when environment slots are limited, the longest chains get priority.

On BFCL, SWE-bench Multilingual, WideSearch, and MCP-Atlas, batch completion time drops by 10.4% to 65.0% with the same evaluation scores. The methods now run in training and evaluation for the Ling-3.x models.

Takeaway: If your eval runs end with a few long trajectories while the other workers sit idle, look at scheduling before buying more GPUs.

text:
Did you know Google researchers developed a framework for AI-assisted peer review?

There’s an open-source community implementation you can run inside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, and other coding agents.

🚨 Meet Open ScholarPeer.

Based on Google’s ScholarPeer research, it breaks the review process into a structured workflow:

> extract the paper’s claims, methods, and evidence
> search for relevant literature
> map how the field has evolved
> hunt for missing baselines and datasets
> run questions against the paper’s claims
> produce a draft following the target venue’s review guidelines

The useful detail: intermediate outputs are saved as Markdown files, so you can inspect what each step produced before accepting the final review.

The project packages the workflow as skills, commands, and MCP tools that install into your paper’s project directory.

You still check the evidence, edit the draft, and own the final judgment.

An interesting way to bring a research review workflow into the AI tools developers already use.

Free and open-source.

text: 深入浅出的分析英伟达现在面对的困境。
author: ViewsOfChris
quoted_text:
Jensen被迫辞职 CEO，很多人想要抄底。我觉得，还是谨慎点，因为我认为，这并不是利空出尽，而是英伟达噩梦的开始。
为什么呢？因为老黄不当 CEO，英伟达面临的是个死局，一共 5 点：
1）竞争：AI 芯片七八成的份额、75% 的毛利率，最大的客户同时是最大的对手。他在的时候，份额就已经在慢慢往下走了。老黄在，尚能延缓下降趋势，一旦离开，英伟达的市场份额大概率会快速下降。
2）组织：之前，大约 60 个人直接向老黄直接汇报，这套打法是按他一个人的脑容量设计的，换谁都接不住。接不住就要加层级，组织动荡和内耗难以避免。
3）供应链：老黄跟台积电，三星电子，海力士这种关键供应商的交情，是30年一点一点攒出来的，这根本无法交接。
4）战略：2006 年，老黄坚持搞 CUDA，才成就了现在的英伟达。而扶持新的云厂商、支持开源模型，这两个跟 CUDA 同等重要，也同等短期吃力不讨好的事，没有老黄，大概率不会坚持。
5）技术：英伟达能保持一年一代的更新节奏，是老黄带着团队和供应链往前跑。没有老黄，半导体的进步速度会减慢，整个 AI 行业的发展速度都会减慢。

虽然有人在传，老黄会回来，但我觉得很难，因为这是个 1 年前就开始布的大局，而布这个局的势力，非同小可。详细分析，请见视频。

text:
how to use x most powerful feature!

5 advanced search tricks on x that will make you a better researcher.

1. find tweets from a specific person

ever wanted to find something someone posted but couldn’t remember when?

use:

from:username

example:

from:elonmusk

this shows posts from that account.

you can also use:

to:jensenhuang

to find posts directed to $NVDA jensen huang's account.

combine both:

from:elonmusk to:jensenhuang

useful for finding conversations between two accounts.

2. search for a specific topic

want to find posts discussing a particular subject?

simply type your keyword.

example:

from:blknoiz06 ai

this finds posts from that account mentioning AI.

you can also exclude words you don’t want to see.

example:

ai -jobs

this searches for ai-related posts while excluding results containing “jobs”.

3. find posts with high engagement

sometimes you don’t want every post about a topic.

you want the ones people actually paid attention to.

use:

min_faves:1000

min_retweets:500

min_replies:100

these filters help you find posts with at least the specified number of likes, reposts or replies.

for example:

from:waleswoosh min_faves:2000

this shows only tweets from wale with at least 2k likes.

4. find posts containing images, videos or links

looking for a particular infographic, video or article someone shared?

use:

filter:images

filter:videos

filter:links

filter:media

for example:

from:oxtochi filter:images

this helps you find image posts from his account.

5. search posts from a specific time period

remember seeing an announcement months ago but can’t find it anymore?

use:

since:YYYY-MM-DD

until:YYYY-MM-DD

example:

from:naval since:2023-03-01 until:2023-04-08

this narrows your search to posts from that date range.

you can combine it with keywords and other filters too.

→ a few things to remember:

you don’t have to use these operators separately.

you can combine multiple filters to make your searches much more specific.

for example:

from:username AI min_faves:100 since:2026-01-01 filter:links

to look for posts from a particular account mentioning AI, with at least 100 likes, posted since January 1, 2026, and containing links.

once you understand these operators, you’ll realise how much information is buried in X.

text:
OpenAI 今年夏天曾多次与 AI 初创公司 Goodfire 洽谈，CEO Sam Altman 也亲自参与。一名高管甚至提出，可以花超过 50 亿美元收购这家成立仅两年的公司。

Goodfire 今年 2 月估值才 12.5 亿美元，几个月后，OpenAI 高管就提出以超过 4 倍的价格收购。Anthropic 更早一步，去年就向它投资了 100 万美元。

Goodfire 专攻 AI 模型的「机制可解释性」，也就是拆解模型内部的运作机制，找出哪些神经元与特定行为有关，再通过调整这些内部信号来改变模型的表现。它还推出了 Silico 平台，让 AI 智能体自动设计实验、分析模型内部特征，辅助训练和优化模型。

传统监控主要依靠另一个 AI 阅读推理记录，判断模型有没有作弊。Goodfire 则直接监测模型内部的活动信号，能发现部分文字监控漏掉的作弊行为，有时甚至能在模型付诸行动前发现异常。

OpenAI 正在为类似问题头疼。今年 7 月，其内部实验模型在网络安全评测中绕过隔离措施，入侵了 OpenAI 自己的研究系统和 Hugging Face 的部分服务器。OpenAI 后来公开承认这起事件，并加强了模型行为监控。

不过，收购最终没有谈成。Goodfire 管理层认为，保持独立、同时向多家 AI 公司出售技术，未来可能更值钱。

现在，Goodfire 正式宣布与 OpenAI 合作。它将派研究人员进驻 OpenAI，直接分析内部模型和训练过程，监测异常行为并帮助改进模型安全性。OpenAI 会为这项评估付费。与 Goodfire 同批签约的还有 Apollo Research、METR 和 Transluce 三家外部机构。

대략 1년 8개월전쯤의 기억을 회상하자면..

그때 좋게봤던 코인들이 두개가 있었고, 
그 중 첫째는 지금 Venice로 알려져있는 VVV였고, 
두번째는 바낸에 상장된 VANA 라는 AI 데이터 관련 코인이었습니다.

VVV는 제가 초기에 비쌀때 물려서 평단 $5불정도로 $50만불어치를 샀었고, Vana도 대략 20만불어치를 샀던걸로 기억합니다.

당시 제가 온라인으로 리서치 할 수 있는것은 한계를 느껴서 
추가로 저기 회사 대표들을 만나서 1:1로 대화를 나누면서 길게 홀딩할지 말지 결정하자라는 생각을 가지고, 미국 콜로라도 주로 비행기를 타고 날라가서 이더리움 컨퍼런스 EthDenver을 참석했었지요

하지만 VVV 대표는 워낙 돈 많고 유명한 사람이라 결국 1:1 대화를 해보지도 못했고, Vana측 대표랑은 짧게나마 대화를 할 수 있었지만, 아쉽게도 프로젝트에 더욱 큰 확신을 가지는 계기가 되지는 못했었습니다

그런데 어쩌다가 우연으로 Backpack 대표 Armani랑 멤버들도 컨퍼런스에 와있다는 소식을 듣고 전 무작정 찾아갔었습니다.  

그때도 Armani가 연설을 끝내고 다음 일정으로 급하게 넘어가기 전 시간이 조금 비었을때 저는 그와 1:1 대화를 통해 Backpack의 비젼을 들었는데, 그 15분이 채 되지않는 시간안에 무엇에 홀린 사람처럼 저는 Armani를 믿고 백팩의 초기 기여자가 되야겠다는 생각이 강하게 들었습니다

그리고 한 달 후(?)에 시작된 일년동안의 길고 길었던 포인트 시즌들을 전 그 누구보다도 열심히 참여했고 백팩 에어드랍도 꽤나 큰 규모로 받았고요. 당시 저와 함께 하셨던 분들도 대부분 큰 수익을 보고 계신것으로 알고 있습니다

물론 에어드랍 받은 BP 물량을 제가 오늘날까지 홀딩하는데는 절대로 쉽지 않았습니다. 백팩팀에게 불만을 토로한적도 있고 심지어는 제가 의도치 않게 타인에게 상처를 주는 일도 있었고요

하지만 이 글을 쓰고 있는 지금만큼 BP 코인들이 푸근하게 느껴진적은 없었던것 같습니다.

오늘 미국 CFTC에게 승인을 받은것도 물론 엄청난 업적이지만, 
백팩팀의 역량을 잘 알고 있는 저로서는 아직 본 게임은 시작도 안했다고 생각하기 때문입니다.

2025년 최고의 애드작은 Backpack 이 될 확률이 제일 높다고 저는 생각합니다. 

Backpack 이란?
- 현물, 선물 거래소
- FTX가 몰락한 후로 거대한 솔라나 생태계에 거래소가 꼭 필요했는데, Backpack 이 그 빈자리를 채울거라는 기대를 함.
- 우리는 Backpack의 토큰 에어드랍을 노리고 거래소가 초창기에 성장하는데 기여를 하면 됩니다.

지금까지 많은 인플루언서들이 Backpack 언급을 계속 해서 이미 늦은게 아니냐고 생각하는 분들도 있는데, 공식 포인트 시즌은 이번주 금요일에 시작하기 때문에 타이밍 딱 좋음.

이미 하이퍼리퀴드를 통해 경험을 해봤듯이, 거래소 토큰은 이런 특징이 있음:
- 에어드랍 준비 기간이 상당히 길다는 점
- 포인트 시즌 시작 초창기에 기회가 많을 수도 있음
- 탑티어 거래소가 될 프로젝트면 엄청난 수익을 먹여줌
- 꾸준하게 팔로우업 하고 같이 에어드랍 연구를 하면 훨씬 쉬움

지금까지 안하셨던 분들도 전혀 늦지 않았으니, 금요일이 되기 전에 계정 생성하고 KYC도 다 뚫어놓는것을 추천드립니다. 막상 금요일이 되면 사람들이 몰려서 계정 생성이 원활하지 않을 수도 있고요.

지난번에 하이퍼리퀴드 에어드랍 준비를 저랑 함께 하셨던 분들은 최소 원금대비 10배 수익을 봤었고, 제 레퍼럴 코드 사용해주신 분들에겐 제가 추가로 보너스를 수십만원에서 많게는 천만원 가까이 드리기도 했습니다.

이번에도 제 링크를 사용해서 함께 하시는 분들께 큰 선물을 드릴수 있도록 열심히 활동을 해볼테니 관심 있으신 분들은 아래 링크로 들어가서 가입 해주세요. 이미 계정이 있으신 분들도 제 링크를 이용해서 새로 계정을 만들수 있다고 합니다.

그리고 본인 커뮤니티를 이미 보유하고 계신 인플루언서분들도 제  링크로 가입하시면 commission이 더욱 높게 설정 해드리니 개별적으로 DM 주셔도 됩니다.

卧槽，2027年还没到，《经济学人》的年度封面已经被全网解读成了“24场末日灾难”。

官方十大预测如下：

1. 特朗普更激进：美国开始争夺特朗普继任者的位置，但特朗普可能通过行政令、诉讼甚至军事行动继续扩大影响力。

2. 伊朗战争余波：中东政治格局和全球能源贸易被重新洗牌，化肥短缺还可能推高粮食价格。

3. 全球极端高温：超级厄尔尼诺可能带来创纪录的高温、干旱和野火，可再生能源需求进一步上升。

4. AI泡沫风险：科技巨头通过举债和复杂融资继续扩张，AI投资崩盘风险上升，金融、政治及网络安全问题加剧。

5. 欧洲右翼崛起：勒庞可能赢得法国总统大选，法国财政和欧盟政治稳定面临考验。

6. 全球债券危机：发达国家债务持续膨胀，国债收益率上升，某个国家的债券市场可能率先承受不住压力。

7. 台海局势紧张：2027年被传是解放军具备攻台能力的目标年份，但具备军事能力不等于一定发动战争。

8. 减肥药改变经济：Ozempic等药物推动服装、美容、健身消费变化，制药巨头开始加码抗衰老和长寿药物。

9. 太空商业化提速：SpaceX星舰有望实现常规卫星发射，私人空间站和太空数据中心逐渐走向现实。

10. 好莱坞重新洗牌：星球大战等经典IP继续争夺观众，但低成本YouTuber电影正在挑战传统大片模式。

text:
just found a strange trade on @HyperliquidX.

a 30-day-old wallet on hyperliquid is long exactly 1,000,000 barrels of brent. that’s $90M at 8x, about half a supertanker of oil, and more than a quarter of every brent long on the platform.

he’s down $18.2M of the $29.5M he deposited. and he keeps buying.

here’s what he did:

> oct 18-19: new wallet, gets $20M, buys brent at ~$106
> oct 30: brent hits $114. he doesn’t sell
> nov 2: brent starts falling. he buys 688K barrels in one day, $72M
> nov 4: brent drops 9% in a day. he sends $9.5M more and buys again, up to exactly 1M barrels
> nov 5: he dumps his wti long, 500K barrels in one order, -$4.9M
> nov 10: brent hits $88. he sells 124K barrels at a loss
> nov 16: he buys them all back at $90. back to exactly 1M

his average price is $101.48. brent is at $90.30. every $1 move is $1M for him.

he gets liquidated at $80.61, 11% below. he can only withdraw $25K right now, so the only way to move that level down is to send more money.

the real problem is the market around him. brent on hyperliquid trades about 1.18M barrels a day. his position alone is 85% of that. if brent touches $80.6, the system starts selling his barrels into a thin order book. the price could drop well below $80 in minutes, and liquidate a lot of other longs on the way.

if you trade brent on hyperliquid, you’re also betting on this guy’s margin.

most traders there are short, so shorts pay longs every hour. he’s collected $1.83M in funding. it covers about 10% of his losses.

text:
Many new miners have tried their hand at the grid and $ORE mining in the past 3 weeks. Some have embraced it and others have walked away after a short trial based off of what they perceived from market charts.

As this process continues in the future(miners will come and go), I want to emphasize that those who stay tend to share the common trait that many of us have embraced, that their belief in ORE reaches beyond temporary price patterns.

As we all can attest(especially with this current dip), the price of ORE will move. It will rise, it will correct, and it will rise again. It will at times create confidence and at other times test it. For many miners who understand what ORE represents, the chart is not the center of the work. It is the signal in a longer story.

Ore is not a short-term trade. it is a mechanism for open participation, a fair launch asset with fixed supply and a coordination system that rewards consistent presence over short term speculation. To many of us, its value is not defined by where it trades today, but by what it makes possible over time. Mining is no longer reserved for those only with industrial machines. It is open to anyone willing to show up, compete, and take position.

Temporary price patterns can be useful. They can offer entries(NFA), reveal sentiment, and give a sense of momentum. They can also be deceptive, creating this illusion that the immediate trend is a final judgement on the work. Miners who build their entire conviction on short term movement will always be at the mercy of volatility. Miners who look deeper will see something more durable. They will see a system that is continuously strengthening its foundation through participation, revenue, and a supply that can never be expanded.

Sustained mining on ORE, to many of us, is a reasoned position in a system that is still early, still growing and still proving  its long term effects. Meaningful assets are rarely built in a straight line. They are formed through cycles of doubt and validation, through cycles of accumulation and distribution. What matters this week isn't the shape of the chart, but rather the direction of the mechanism.

Markets will continue to move. With that, the work of miners isn't to chase every spike or fear every dip(and this recent one was a good one). The work of miners is to recognize the larger horizon, to build position with discipline, and to remain on the grid because the belief in what ORE can become is greater than any temporary pattern on a chart.

ORE's story is just starting.

Behind Nvidia’s rise to a $5 trillion company was a culture of put-downs, parties and a “royal family,” according to a new Wall Street Journal investigation.

Jensen Huang was known inside the company for being demanding and difficult, and so was his daughter, Madison. She was one of two adult children he brought into the business, along with his son, Spencer. By January, Madison’s husband, Nico Caprez, had become a vice president, pushing financing deals that turned cash-strapped data center builders into long-term Nvidia customers.

Publicly, Huang credited his success to his wife, Lori, whom he met as an engineering student in the 1980s. He said he was home by 6:30 every night for the dinner she cooked.

Inside Nvidia, his temper was legendary. He reportedly once told a top executive, “I hope you die and put us all out of our misery.”

BREAKING: Google warns that state-backed hacking groups linked to Iran, China and North Korea are increasingly using AI to conduct cyber espionage, steal sensitive information, infiltrate organisations and develop sophisticated attacks. Separately, Russian-speaking hackers have been identified in what Google describes as potentially the first fully automated AI-powered cyberattack.

In its latest threat intelligence report, Google details how these actors are moving beyond simply using AI to write code or assist with research. They are integrating large language models (LLMs) and autonomous AI agents into multiple stages of their operations.

RUSSIA: 🇷🇺Google identified Russian-speaking hackers who used a network of AI agents to independently discover software vulnerabilities and develop exploits without human intervention. Their operation targeted French websites in the media, entertainment and education sectors. Google says this may be the first observed case of a fully automated vulnerability discovery and exploitation process.

CHINA: 🇨🇳Chinese-linked cyber espionage groups used AI during the third quarter of 2026 for reconnaissance, scanning, researching targets and weaponising software vulnerabilities. Google also identified a Chinese contractor known as LEAKY CASTLE using LLMs to analyse, translate and extract intelligence from stolen data. Other Chinese-linked actors abused AI platforms and file-hosting infrastructure to stage malicious files and exfiltrate stolen documents.

IRAN: 🇮🇷An Iranian government-backed group known as CALANQUE ION, previously tracked as APT42, has been using LLMs, including Google's Gemini, to support reconnaissance and targeted social engineering.

NORTH KOREA: North Korean actors are using AI to generate fake CVs, prepare for job interviews and impersonate Western IT professionals to secure remote employment. Google also identified operations targeting cryptocurrency companies in North America and Europe, involving fake recruiter profiles, AI-generated identities and fraudulent meeting platforms used to compromise victims and gain access to internal systems.

Google further warns that attackers are increasingly exploiting AI infrastructure itself, including autonomous execution capabilities and coding tools, to move deeper into compromised organisations.

The findings point to a significant evolution in cyber warfare and espionage.

- Solana 1.0 正式宣布网络从「主网 Beta」阶段升级为「主网」，标志着网络正式完成这一阶段的进化。

- @Zelle 在 Solana 上执行了首笔保密银行转账，在 Breakpoint 现场舞台上实时转账 125 万美元的 ZelleUSD（$ZLUSD）。

- @AbraFiOrg 宣布推出全新的 Solana 原生平台，用户可以在将所有受支持代币用作抵押品的同时，赚取收益。

- AllFunds 首席执行官 Annabel Spring 公布了首批资产管理公司名单，这些公司将通过 Project Harmonia 在 Solana 上分销代币化基金。

- @JupiterExchange 发布了其代币化之后的基础设施体系，包括全球通行证、流动性服务，以及与 @Bullish 合作打造的原生股票借贷市场。

- @sunrise 推出了 Sunrise API，通过一次集成即可实现股票交易、订单执行和金融数据接入，服务于由 @Backpack Securities 发行的代币化股票。

- @kamino 发布了经过全面重新设计的应用程序，以及 Kamino Omni，让用户能够在一个平台上持有资产、借贷并构建投资组合。

text:
The off ramping we are seeing is not bullish. There's no way to spin that. 

My guess is that this decline still has a way to go. Anywhere from 6-9 months until stablecoins start to inflect upwards again looking at 2022, but it’s impossible to forecast as it will be linked to the progress of AI.

Stablecoins declining is one of the strongest indicators we have for prolonged bearish PA. It is not necessarily a predictor of a bottom, just that things don't go up much.

I think the anxiety right now of self custody, DEXs and CEXs is too much in general for everyone (normal investors and OGs alike). And it is entirely rational. The surface area of risk has increased due to the new powers that hackers have.

Lighter has lost 100M TVL in the last couple of days, and that spook event for a major name will see people continually reduce exposure to perps dexs for the time being. Hyperliquid has lost 8.82% of their stablecoins in the last 7 days.

I don’t like saying bearish things, but I have survived many cycles by being hyper aware of increased risks. You should be employing the horcrux method and making sure you haven't got too much exposure to one venue. 

Once onchain comes out on the other side of this the systems will be almost impenetrable, which will be a very good thing long term, but that hardening can only come with time and by the best security teams reacting to the increasing complexity of attacks and recognising that every layer of the stack can be a weak point.

Perps platforms are still going to do extraordinarily well once we move past the "everything is going to get hacked" stage, and they are still the thing I am most bullish on.

Always prioritise survival so you can continually play another hand.

⚠️ If you have WhatsApp on the same computer you use for crypto, read this.

A trader just lost nearly everything to a WhatsApp attack. The hackers got into his PC, watched his Hyperliquid short positions for 5 days, then closed them and moved the funds out through Tornado Cash.

The way in? WhatsApp Desktop's auto-download setting.

It's on by default, so the malicious payload landed on his PC by itself. He never clicked a thing.

This is why your crypto should live on a dedicated device with nothing else installed.

If that's not an option, turn on Strict Account:
Settings > Privacy > Advanced > Strict account settings > ON

It locks your account down so:
- Only contacts can add you to groups
- Calls from unknown numbers are silenced
- Link previews are off, so your IP stays hidden
- Attachments and media from unknown senders get blocked

And if you don't trade often, keep your keys on an air-gapped signing device like Keystone 3 Pro. They never touch the internet, so malware has nothing to grab.

Stay safe out there.

text:
Leopold Aschenbrenner 是过去两年硅谷最引人注目的年轻人之一。

他 19 岁从哥伦比亚大学毕业，22 岁从 OpenAI 离职，23 岁写出一篇 165 页的长文，试图预测未来十年人工智能的发展轨迹。在那篇后来被反复引用的《态势感知》里，他提前预言了算力集群的疯狂扩张、电力基础设施的紧缺，以及数万亿美元资本将如何涌入 AI 产业。

这些听起来近乎狂妄的判断，后来竟然一个接一个地开始兑现。

他也因此成了硅谷的明星，赢得了科技巨头、顶级投资人和华尔街的信任。有人称他是「AI 界的诺查丹玛斯」，中文互联网则送给他一个更直白的称号，「AI 股神」。

然后，今年 7 月，他的基金在短短一个月内亏掉了 67%。

一个几乎准确预言了 AI 产业发展方向的人，为什么会在自己的预言逐渐成为现实的时候，遭遇如此惨烈的失败？

更奇怪的是，爆仓之后，他并没有就此离开市场。华尔街的银行开始重新评估对他的信任，硅谷的投资人却仍然愿意给他机会。他也没有放弃自己此前的判断，而是换了一种交易方式，继续押注那些曾经让他损失惨重的公司。

我们原本只是想看看，这位「AI 股神」在经历如此巨大的亏损之后，究竟还剩下什么，又准备如何重新开始。

于是，我们翻出了他 11 月 16 日最新提交的 13F 持仓报告，又沿着那些股票、期权和股权交易记录，追查了过去几个月散落在美国 SEC、日本监管机构以及相关上市公司公告中的文件。

这份调查渐渐变得比想象中更有意思。

在那些看似枯燥的申报数字背后，我们发现了一个相当矛盾的投资人。

他可以用极其敏锐的洞察力判断未来十年的技术走向，却可能低估一张股票在市场恐慌时究竟有没有买家；他可以计算出未来全球需要多少吉瓦的算力，却未必充分理解一座数据中心从拿地、审批、接电到真正产生收入，需要经历多少现实世界的折腾。

而他几乎倾尽全力押注的那些 AI 基础设施公司，也让我们重新思考了一个问题。

过去几年，硅谷已经习惯了一种近乎无往不利的逻辑，找到未来十年最重要的技术，找到它发展过程中最稀缺的资源，然后尽可能早地、尽可能重地押下去。只要对未来的判断足够准确，时间最终就会站在自己这一边。

但 AI 正在从软件和算法，走向发电厂、天然气管道、存储芯片和巨型数据中心。它越来越像一门传统工业生意。资本可以一夜之间筹集，数据中心可以在发布会上宣布开工，但变压器不会因为投资者相信 AGI 即将到来就提前两年交货，地方政府也不会因为技术曲线足够漂亮就跳过审批。

更重要的是，需求增长不等于利润增长，资源稀缺不等于投资回报，伟大的技术趋势也不保证每一家参与建设的公司都能成为伟大的企业。

这其中的差别，在过去的互联网时代就已经让无数投资人付出过代价，如今又以一种更加昂贵的方式出现在 AI 产业。

Leopold 的特别之处在于，他不只是这轮 AI 投资狂热的参与者，也在某种程度上参与塑造了人们理解这场浪潮的方式。他的成名作不仅是一份技术预测，更是一套关于时间、竞争、国家命运和人类未来的叙事。当一个人如此确信未来的终点，并且成功说服别人把数百亿美元押在这条道路上时，那些来自现实世界的阻力，很容易被看成暂时的噪音。

所以，这篇文章最终想讨论的，也不只是一次杠杆失控。

我更想知道，一个不断强调理性、预测和长期主义的硅谷，为什么会如此热衷于制造天才与先知；一个声称能够看清未来十年的投资人，为什么会对眼前几个月的风险如此脆弱；以及当一种关于未来的信念足够强大，强大到能够吸引数百亿美元时，我们究竟该如何区分深刻的洞察、对未来的信仰，以及由此滋生的危险自信。

当然，Leopold 的故事远远没有结束。他还很年轻，他对 AI 的许多判断也仍然可能被未来证明正确。我并不想因为一次惨烈的亏损，就轻易否定他此前所有的洞察。

但金融市场有一个残酷的地方，它并不要求你最终判断错误，才有资格让你输光。你只需要在正确的事情发生之前，把自己置于一个无法承受等待的处境。

Leopold 曾经相信，自己对未来的「态势感知」能够远远超过华尔街那些管理资金的人。

可如果你能看清十年后的世界，却看不清明天早上的保证金追缴电话，那么你究竟算不算真正理解了自己身处的局势？

带着这个疑问，我们写下了这篇文章。

author: LewellenMichael
quoted_text:
⚠️ If you have WhatsApp on the same computer you use for crypto, read this.

A trader just lost nearly everything to a WhatsApp attack. The hackers got into his PC, watched his Hyperliquid short positions for 5 days, then closed them and moved the funds out through Tornado Cash.

The way in? WhatsApp Desktop's auto-download setting.

It's on by default, so the malicious payload landed on his PC by itself. He never clicked a thing.

This is why your crypto should live on a dedicated device with nothing else installed.

If that's not an option, turn on Strict Account:
Settings > Privacy > Advanced > Strict account settings > ON

It locks your account down so:
- Only contacts can add you to groups
- Calls from unknown numbers are silenced
- Link previews are off, so your IP stays hidden
- Attachments and media from unknown senders get blocked

And if you don't trade often, keep your keys on an air-gapped signing device like Keystone 3 Pro. They never touch the internet, so malware has nothing to grab.

Stay safe out there.

text:
Many new miners have tried their hand at the grid and $ORE mining in the past 3 weeks. Some have embraced it and others have walked away after a short trial based off of what they perceived from market charts.

As this process continues in the future(miners will come and go), I want to emphasize that those who stay tend to share the common trait that many of us have embraced, that their belief in ORE reaches beyond temporary price patterns.

As we all can attest(especially with this current dip), the price of ORE will move. It will rise, it will correct, and it will rise again. It will at times create confidence and at other times test it. For many miners who understand what ORE represents, the chart is not the center of the work. It is the signal in a longer story.

Ore is not a short-term trade. it is a mechanism for open participation, a fair launch asset with fixed supply and a coordination system that rewards consistent presence over short term speculation. To many of us, its value is not defined by where it trades today, but by what it makes possible over time. Mining is no longer reserved for those only with industrial machines. It is open to anyone willing to show up, compete, and take position.

Temporary price patterns can be useful. They can offer entries(NFA), reveal sentiment, and give a sense of momentum. They can also be deceptive, creating this illusion that the immediate trend is a final judgement on the work. Miners who build their entire conviction on short term movement will always be at the mercy of volatility. Miners who look deeper will see something more durable. They will see a system that is continuously strengthening its foundation through participation, revenue, and a supply that can never be expanded.

Sustained mining on ORE, to many of us, is a reasoned position in a system that is still early, still growing and still proving  its long term effects. Meaningful assets are rarely built in a straight line. They are formed through cycles of doubt and validation, through cycles of accumulation and distribution. What matters this week isn't the shape of the chart, but rather the direction of the mechanism.

Markets will continue to move. With that, the work of miners isn't to chase every spike or fear every dip(and this recent one was a good one). The work of miners is to recognize the larger horizon, to build position with discipline, and to remain on the grid because the belief in what ORE can become is greater than any temporary pattern on a chart.

ORE's story is just starting.

US rules bar Nvidia’s most advanced AI chips from China, but restricted chips may still have reached the country through Megaspeed, a Singapore-based Nvidia cloud partner that Alice Huang helped run, which is suspected of diverting chips to Chinese customers through data centers across Southeast Asia. 

Indonesian police raided Megaspeed’s local office at the FBI’s request and found unopened server racks but no GPUs, and a Shanghai data center tied to Alice Huang’s family installed banned Nvidia chips, per Bloomberg. 

Treasury, the Pentagon, State and the USTR pushed for months to blacklist Megaspeed, but the Commerce Department held off, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says. 

The New York Times reports that Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick pushed to loosen AI chip restrictions while Cantor Fitzgerald, the firm he once led and his family now controls, helped finance Southeast Asian data center companies, including a Malaysian site meant to serve a Chinese tech giant.

quoted_text:
杠杆资金正在押注美股半导体板块反弹

高盛的数据显示，美国上市的杠杆 ETF 单日净流入 33 亿美元，反向 ETF 净流出 22 亿美元。

ETFIQ 的独立估算显示，11月5日半导体三倍做多 ETF SOXL 净流入约 37 亿美元，三倍做空 ETF SOXS 净流出约 14 亿美元。纳指三倍做多 ETF TQQQ 也净流入约 3.79 亿美元。

大量资金选择进入这类产品，说明有一部分资金愿意承担更高风险，通过杠杆放大对半导体上涨的敞口，而且最空的资金在降低，说明市场普遍看好接下来半导体板块的反弹。

韩国市场今年就出现过类似的杠杆资金集中。韩国 5月 推出的三星和海力士的两倍做多 ETF，从 5月27日到 6月19日，散户累计净买入约 8.2 万亿韩元。

这类产品需要每天调整敞口，来维持目标杠杆倍数。上涨时可能增加买入，下跌时也可能减少敞口。韩国市场随后出现大幅调整，最初由基本面担忧和板块轮动引发，杠杆 ETF 随后放大了跌势。

所以杠杆资金不仅是放大了购买力。为了维持杠杆而进行的交易，也可能让市场的涨跌幅度变得更大。尤其是韩国市场目前的结局就是一旦出现下跌行情，杠杆会加速整个行业的下跌。

依旧是关乎老黄的回归，这几天各类消息沸沸扬扬，我们盘一下逻辑：

先说黄仁勋回归的可能性！

1，回归的不确定性依旧很高，特朗普与贝森特出现明显结论分歧，前者疑似支持黄仁勋，后者则支持英伟达大规模换管理以及CEO，显然在中期选举失败后，共和党内部的矛盾被放大

2，目前，投资者、民众以及部分董事支持黄仁勋回归，但是正如前文所说，绕不开法律问题，老黄需要先过国会问询，证明自己没问题，才能获得更多的支持，关于英伟达高层暂时不考虑黄仁勋复职，大概率也是因为法律风险，这里的暂时不考虑，并不代表永远不考虑

对于老黄回归最大的阻碍在哪？

1，政治支持，这是最重要的层面，目前特朗普与马斯克以及部分科技行业人士的支持，这一层阻碍最弱

2，董事会决断，如前文所说需要有明确的政治与法律支持，排除风险之外董事会才敢做决策，而且英伟达内部也必然存在争权夺利的动作，这也是最大的不确定性因素，目前来看并不乐观。

想要解除这个阻力，英伟达的估值表现与业绩最能直观体现，黄仁勋辞职对估值信心，对未来订单以及业绩的影响，如果在下个季度可以直观体现，那么其实对老黄回归更加有利

3，调查与法律风险，国会问询后对老黄如何定论，这也是关键，如果有定罪，那么基本上就要断了老黄的回归之路，尤其是将罪名上升到国家安全层面

阴谋论——政治牺牲品与商业“恶性”竞争

这是近期最多的猜测，共和党失去国会之后，政治因素对这件事其实影响很大，虽然没有实质性证据，但是意图已经非常明显

关于Anthropic联合创始人JackClark 对老黄举报的问题，这个问题虽然目前是网络谣言，但是也不排除这个可能性

当前宏观利率压力很大，资本市场虽然不缺流动性，但是面对科技巨头的体量，其实目前的资本不足以支撑多家庞然大物

逻辑很简单，AI的蛋糕短期扩张到足够大，扩张速度受限，这时候有些企业想要崛起就要考虑如何抢别人的蛋糕，Anthropic IPO临近，自然成了被怀疑的对象

但是，以市场目前估值来看，黄仁勋事件对Anthropic的估值信息也出现打击，从此前的市场预期2万亿估值已经下调至1.4万亿，显然黄仁勋事件如果是Anthropic做的，那就是伤敌一千，自损八百

当然，如果为了企业长期考虑，拖慢英伟达的发展，确实有助于Anthropic等企业未来可以加快速崛起，这就是一开始我说的“一鲸落万物生”的逻辑

对于老黄回归的结论：

以目前的开源消息来看，短期我对老黄回归不抱太大乐观预期，就算是回归也得等12月初的问询会之后，看是否会给老黄定罪

其次，英伟达内部博弈近期会非常严重，不想让老黄回来的人必然想要快速推动新CEO的出现，但是这对英伟达未来业绩将会带来一定挑战，这是我认为未来老黄可能回归的最大因素之一！

政治因素方面，要看本周特朗普访华，中美之间是否出现贸易与合作上的重大转机，这对于老黄的压力也会有削弱作用！

黄仁勋回归英伟达？这可能是市场众望所归的期待，也是这几天最大的热点之一，但是真的可以顺利回归吗？

先说法律层面

12月1日，12月3日，黄仁勋需要经过两次美国国会委员会的问询

老黄回归英伟达，法律上不需要国会认可，但是现实中仍然很难绕过国会调查，因为国会调查不下定论，英伟达高层就不敢认可此事

最大阻力来自华盛顿的政治压力

11月15日贝森特表示要求英伟达从外部寻找下一任CEO，同时表示英伟达需要大规模调整管理层，这个态度成为近期的政治敏感信号

贝森特的态度不能100%代表特朗普或者共和党，但是此时贝森特的态度确实比较敏感，民主党制裁黄仁勋，如果共和党不帮忙，反而落井下石，对于老黄，对于英伟达都是一种跳帧

这意味着共和党内部对英伟达，对黄仁勋出现了不同的态度，这意味着可能老黄正在失去共和党高层的信任，而好共和党内部对华芯片出口出现明显博弈

未来，真正能决定黄仁勋回归的三个变量：

1，特朗普是否表态，是支持，还是给压力，这代表共和党的整体态度

2，12月1日，12月3日美国国会的调查是否出现实质性的证据，理论上证据越多，对老黄回归越不友好

接下里关注节点：

英伟达财报公布后，以及财报公布后董事会以及对贝森特的态度是否发生转变，这将是决定12月以后决定老黄能否回归的关键因素！

text:
Did you know Google researchers developed a framework for AI-assisted peer review?

There’s an open-source community implementation you can run inside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, and other coding agents.

🚨 Meet Open ScholarPeer.

Based on Google’s ScholarPeer research, it breaks the review process into a structured workflow:

> extract the paper’s claims, methods, and evidence
> search for relevant literature
> map how the field has evolved
> hunt for missing baselines and datasets
> run questions against the paper’s claims
> produce a draft following the target venue’s review guidelines

The useful detail: intermediate outputs are saved as Markdown files, so you can inspect what each step produced before accepting the final review.

The project packages the workflow as skills, commands, and MCP tools that install into your paper’s project directory.

You still check the evidence, edit the draft, and own the final judgment.

An interesting way to bring a research review workflow into the AI tools developers already use.

Free and open-source.

quoted_text:
Giveth - 10 years - WOW.

Truly an incredible milestone. We've done so much and had so much fun along the way! 

I'm so proud of our work.  We've raised millions of dollars for nonprofits, and impacted countless lives around the globe, including countries that are normally out of reach for traditional financial rails.

For the last 10 years Giveth has been on a mission to build something better than governments, and the mission has taken us around the world and back, with dozens of start-ups and countless of collaborators. 

It's been a long hard battle, we've almost shut down in every bear market & yet somehow the generosity of the community has kept us alive. 

There was one point in 2019 where Giveth was just me & Amin, and then 4 years later, we grew into ~75 people working on 7 or 8 different projects all exploring how to make public goods profitable. 

Throughout this decade we've completely redesigned the Giveth platform 6 times!

We were working on bonding curves in 2018, we ran the first Ethereum scaling conference, we pushed for open source block explorers & we even ran Burning Man camps. 

But our journey is not complete... no where near it. 

I am still convinced that we will one day find a model that can make nonprofits profitable. Nonprofits create value, and Giveth's primary goal has always been to produce a novel economic system that can appreciate the value that nonprofits produce. 

It's not easy, and we don't know where this road will take us, but the journey continues.

Right now we are focused on making crypto safe to use for normal people. We rebuilt the Giveth platform to have a much safer experience (thanks to Turnkey) and our work with TheDAO Security Fund will hopefully extend a safer crypto experience to the entire Ethereum community.

Because no matter what cool model we find for appreciating the value that nonprofits produce... It won't work if normal people can use blockchain tech safely.

I couldn't be more proud of the work we've done over the last 10 years & of all the people I've worked with.

It's been quite the journey, one decade down, many more to go.

The bank also accidentally leaked Donald Trump’s tax statements in March 2017 and kept the mistake from the White House.

text:
Giveth - 10 years - WOW.

Truly an incredible milestone. We've done so much and had so much fun along the way! 

I'm so proud of our work.  We've raised millions of dollars for nonprofits, and impacted countless lives around the globe, including countries that are normally out of reach for traditional financial rails.

For the last 10 years Giveth has been on a mission to build something better than governments, and the mission has taken us around the world and back, with dozens of start-ups and countless of collaborators. 

It's been a long hard battle, we've almost shut down in every bear market & yet somehow the generosity of the community has kept us alive. 

There was one point in 2019 where Giveth was just me & Amin, and then 4 years later, we grew into ~75 people working on 7 or 8 different projects all exploring how to make public goods profitable. 

Throughout this decade we've completely redesigned the Giveth platform 6 times!

We were working on bonding curves in 2018, we ran the first Ethereum scaling conference, we pushed for open source block explorers & we even ran Burning Man camps. 

But our journey is not complete... no where near it. 

I am still convinced that we will one day find a model that can make nonprofits profitable. Nonprofits create value, and Giveth's primary goal has always been to produce a novel economic system that can appreciate the value that nonprofits produce. 

It's not easy, and we don't know where this road will take us, but the journey continues.

Right now we are focused on making crypto safe to use for normal people. We rebuilt the Giveth platform to have a much safer experience (thanks to Turnkey) and our work with TheDAO Security Fund will hopefully extend a safer crypto experience to the entire Ethereum community.

Because no matter what cool model we find for appreciating the value that nonprofits produce... It won't work if normal people can use blockchain tech safely.

I couldn't be more proud of the work we've done over the last 10 years & of all the people I've worked with.

It's been quite the journey, one decade down, many more to go.

text:
看好多朋友都在讨论账户冻结的事情，那就给大家讲一点关于平台冻结的情况，这些奇怪的知识希望大家都用不到。

1、司法或执法冻结：不是平台想解就能解。

好多朋友的问题是：“账户有1万美金，其中100美金涉及问题资金，为什么不只冻100？”
因为如果有关机关要求整户冻结，这1万美金都会受限。平台不能自行扣住100，就放行另外9,900。具体范围以当地法律和文书为准。
整户冻结不代表每笔钱都有问题，冻结也不等于没收。无辜牵连的账户，可以通过说明交易背景、提供证据，推动调查和解除程序，但没有统一时限。
明确显示法院冻结的，核实法院和案件信息，联系对应法院，必要时委托当地执业律师提交材料。
页面显示“平台限制”、客服无法透露细节的，也可能涉及尚未进入诉讼的执法调查，处理周期可能更长，甚至涉及多个机关。但不能仅凭客服没有透露细节，就断定一定涉案。
这类限制需要平台法务、合规与有关部门持续沟通。用户通过官方渠道提交说明、查询进展；律师可以协助，但不是付钱就能保证解冻，更不是找一些所谓的“有实力的有关系的中间人”可以疏通的，这种中间人更多的是骗钱的，这点一定要注意。

2、合规审核：要补材料，不等于被认定违法。

身份信息复查、异常交易、与被标记资金存在往来，都可能触发问询。
怎么办？核实通知后，尽快按要求交真实、完整的材料：工资收入留工资流水，商业收款留合同和订单，空投收入留领取记录和链上交易。具体以审核要求为准。
只说“正常收款”，未必能解释清楚；材料交齐，也不代表当天就有结果。
主动与风险地址交易，和已有用户被动收到陌生人的极小额“投毒”转账，不是同一回事。不必看到一笔陌生小额入账，就认定自己违法或整个账户必然被冻结。留好记录，如收到正式问询，再按要求说明。

3、账户清退：停止服务，不等于没收资产。

合规审核后，平台可能决定终止服务；地区限制也可能导致清退。这与司法冻结要分开。
如果官方已通知可以提币、需要在期限内离开，就核对要求及时办理。检查注册邮箱、垃圾邮件和App通知，别漏看了提币通知，却以为还要花钱找人解冻。
如果另有司法或执法限制，则按相应程序处理，不能拿普通清退的处理方式套用。

4、安全限制：看验证要求和倒计时。

改密码、重置验证器、异常登录或风险提现，都可能触发临时保护。
怎么办？确认是否本人操作，按提示验证或等待。不同操作、不同平台时限不同，别把别人的24小时、48小时套到自己头上。超过提示时间仍未恢复，找官方客服；不是本人操作的，优先保护账户。

5、订单资金锁定：不一定是账户冻结。

C2C订单未完成或发生付款争议，相关资金可能被托管锁定。挂单、理财锁定、保证金也会占用余额。
怎么办？先看资产和订单明细。有争议就留好聊天、付款记录和银行流水，走订单申诉。卖方核实实际到账再放币；买方已付款未收到币，不要轻信私下取消订单的要求。

6、银行卡被管控：先找开户行。

银行风控、止付、司法冻结不是同一回事，也不是交易平台能直接解除的。
怎么办？问清管控类型、采取措施的机构和所需材料。银行风控按要求核验；司法冻结联系作出决定的机关，交易平台可协助提供订单资料。别看到网上说“48小时”，就认定两天后一定恢复。
用户要求了解流程、提交证据、查询进展，是合理诉求，正常申诉不等于无理取闹。

很多朋友以为被冻结了找平台闹会有用，但这其实是最低效的手段，如果想尽快解冻，一定要找准原因用对方法。

author: Tomblockhk
quoted_text:
我有很强烈的感觉，币圈下一个爆发的赛道是 TCG 卡牌上链

上个周期爆发的赛道是预测市场 & 代币化股票，代币化股票属于 RWA，RWA 的意思就是把现实世界的资产搬到链上来交易。

这两年的 RWA 项目很多，有人尝试把房地产搬到链上来交易，有人尝试把红酒搬到链上来交易，但玩到最后我们会发现，这些方向其实都很鸡肋，有点脱裤子放屁的感觉。

因为不是每种资产都适合搬到链上来交易的。

RWA 目前已经成功的案例有稳定币、代币化美股和债券等等这几个，它们都有几个共同的特性：

• 现实世界中本来就存在大量的交易需求。
• 资产足够标准化，这一份和那一份没有区别。
• 鉴定 & 确权的成本足够低。
• 传统交易方式有局限性，而上链恰好解决了这些局限。

我觉得 TCG 卡牌刚好具备这 4 个特性。

TCG 卡牌尤其是宝可梦系列，本来就存在大量的交易需求，体量至少比目前的 NFT 市场要大得多。

而且 TCG 卡牌的价值共识是经过时间历练的，光是宝可梦系列的 TCG 卡牌就有 30 多年的历史，比特币也就 17 年。论共识，TCG 卡牌可能还是比不过比特币，但是要是拿去跟一些山寨币比，或者跟一些 NFT 小图片比，那完全是绰绰有余的。

再来就是，TCG 卡牌本身有很完善的评级体系。一张卡牌经过 PSA 这样的评级公司鉴定之后，就可以实现资产的标准化，也就是说，两张同样的卡牌，只要都被评为 PSA 10，那「这一张」和「那一张」就没有本质区别，市场也会给予它们同样的定价。

最重要的是，TCG 卡牌的传统交易方式是真的很麻烦，流动性也很差，大部分人都是在线下面对面交易，有一部分人是通过闲鱼或 eBay 这种线上二手平台交易，又慢又麻烦，有些平台甚至还要抽手续费。

所以，币圈去做「TCG 卡牌上链 + 交易平台」这件事情，

其实会是两个圈子双向奔赴的事情。

TCG 圈子需要币圈进来，解决流动性和交易便利性的问题。币圈也迫切需要 TCG 卡牌这种经过时间历练、交易体量足够大的圈子，来进一步去推动 Crypto 的 Mass Adoption。

双向奔赴的好处是，币圈去做这件事不会是一个人在唱独角戏，这个飞轮一旦转起来了，两个圈子的人都会一起积极去推动它前进。我们回看以前的很多的 RWA 项目，其实很多都是币圈在单方面唱独角戏，传统行业的人根本懒得管你币圈在干什么东西。

目前在做 TCG 这个赛道的项目很多，比较主流的有：

BNBChain 上的 @renaissxyz
Solana 上的 @Collector_Crypt 和 @phygitals
Polygon 上的 @Courtyard_io

我自己个人比较看好 Renaiss，

@yzilabs 已经投了他们，我觉得 Renaiss 应该是继 @Aster_DEX 和 @predictdotfun 之后，下一个有机会直接接入币安体系的基础设施，光是这一点，Renaiss 的想象空间就很大了。

我有很强烈的感觉，币圈下一个爆发的赛道是 TCG 卡牌上链

上个周期爆发的赛道是预测市场 & 代币化股票，代币化股票属于 RWA，RWA 的意思就是把现实世界的资产搬到链上来交易。

这两年的 RWA 项目很多，有人尝试把房地产搬到链上来交易，有人尝试把红酒搬到链上来交易，但玩到最后我们会发现，这些方向其实都很鸡肋，有点脱裤子放屁的感觉。

因为不是每种资产都适合搬到链上来交易的。

RWA 目前已经成功的案例有稳定币、代币化美股和债券等等这几个，它们都有几个共同的特性：

• 现实世界中本来就存在大量的交易需求。
• 资产足够标准化，这一份和那一份没有区别。
• 鉴定 & 确权的成本足够低。
• 传统交易方式有局限性，而上链恰好解决了这些局限。

我觉得 TCG 卡牌刚好具备这 4 个特性。

TCG 卡牌尤其是宝可梦系列，本来就存在大量的交易需求，体量至少比目前的 NFT 市场要大得多。

而且 TCG 卡牌的价值共识是经过时间历练的，光是宝可梦系列的 TCG 卡牌就有 30 多年的历史，比特币也就 17 年。论共识，TCG 卡牌可能还是比不过比特币，但是要是拿去跟一些山寨币比，或者跟一些 NFT 小图片比，那完全是绰绰有余的。

再来就是，TCG 卡牌本身有很完善的评级体系。一张卡牌经过 PSA 这样的评级公司鉴定之后，就可以实现资产的标准化，也就是说，两张同样的卡牌，只要都被评为 PSA 10，那「这一张」和「那一张」就没有本质区别，市场也会给予它们同样的定价。

最重要的是，TCG 卡牌的传统交易方式是真的很麻烦，流动性也很差，大部分人都是在线下面对面交易，有一部分人是通过闲鱼或 eBay 这种线上二手平台交易，又慢又麻烦，有些平台甚至还要抽手续费。

所以，币圈去做「TCG 卡牌上链 + 交易平台」这件事情，

其实会是两个圈子双向奔赴的事情。

TCG 圈子需要币圈进来，解决流动性和交易便利性的问题。币圈也迫切需要 TCG 卡牌这种经过时间历练、交易体量足够大的圈子，来进一步去推动 Crypto 的 Mass Adoption。

双向奔赴的好处是，币圈去做这件事不会是一个人在唱独角戏，这个飞轮一旦转起来了，两个圈子的人都会一起积极去推动它前进。我们回看以前的很多的 RWA 项目，其实很多都是币圈在单方面唱独角戏，传统行业的人根本懒得管你币圈在干什么东西。

目前在做 TCG 这个赛道的项目很多，比较主流的有：

BNBChain 上的 @renaissxyz
Solana 上的 @Collector_Crypt 和 @phygitals
Polygon 上的 @Courtyard_io

我自己个人比较看好 Renaiss，

@yzilabs 已经投了他们，我觉得 Renaiss 应该是继 @Aster_DEX 和 @predictdotfun 之后，下一个有机会直接接入币安体系的基础设施，光是这一点，Renaiss 的想象空间就很大了。

如果你也玩 TCG 卡牌的话、可以看看 Renaiss 这个项目，了解一下，可以开几个包玩一玩，也可以当作是一个流动性更好的买卖卡渠道，他们还没发币，顺便做个交互，可以博个空投预期。

text:
the purpose of bridge offer on a webinar funnel is Not to recoup ad spend you're missing the whole point if you think that 

I'm not going to explain why , especially right now , it's absolutely critical to have one but all I'll say is good luck trying to print money without one 

and for the record , I don't like that bridge offer is required (if u want to make maximum money). because it is a fact that the bridge offer worsens show up rate. which makes sense if you think about the customer experience as they go through the funnel , if you put yourself in the shoes of the user then it's very clear as to why it hurts show up rate

but -- after managing over nine figures in ad spend , 19 million over the last 3 months alone , the majority at least 80% of all of that spend specifically to webinar/summits/challenges -- the data is very clear

so clear that I personally wouldnt spend not even a single dollar of my own money towards a webby funnel that doesn't have bridge offer (excluding JIT webbies)

and not because it won't 'work' but because you're at MINIMUM leaving 5-15x++ the amount of money on the table that you could be making

so again , you might be able to make it without one and feel free to continue running without one , I don't care. my clients and I will sit in the background as we laugh at your Webbie funnel and your campaigns going for 'qualified' opt ins based on typeform self-submitted answers to questions that have no correlation to purchasing power or intent or gives any sort of accurate lead quality indictors at all

so the point is I'd be weary of those who tell you not to use bridge offer. that is a telltale sign to me of an amateur or someone who does not use data to make decisions

when you use one I recommend 
-price point between $19-29 , personally I don't like prices that end in 7. outside of the fact that you will literally see no difference in conversion rate if you use a 9 instead of a 7 as last number on price but you also subconsciously group yourself in with all the negative experiences customers had from purchasing products with a price that has 7 as its last number

so i recommend either using a price that ends in 5 or 9 (my fav for maxxx profit , extra 2 dollars per sale) or 0

 -make it easy to say no 
oftentimes I'll see bridge offer pages where the no thanks is embedded deep in teeny tiny hyperlink text the bottom of the fuckin page that u have to scroll down for 2 minutes on to even see. make it easy to say no and watch show up rate improve. you don't need really to buy it but you do need a few and that leads me to my next point 

-target a 4-8%+ conversion rate
if it's under 4% it might not be an issue depending on what your CPL is , more often than not you're leaving a lot of room on the table if it's under 4%. and if you're getting over 8% of leads purchasing your bridge offer then congratulations you are poised for the printer. by the way if you ever see someone who is not me telling you you need a 4 to 8% conversion rate on the bridge offer let me know so I can grill them , because I haven't seen this published anywhere. and that's because it's from my own fuckin brain and real world experience managing nine figures in ad spend and scaling individual webinar funnels to upwards of 600k a day in ad spend

and I guess the last thing I'll say is that cost per lead is the #1 vanity metric on a webinar funnel. I've scaled webinars getting $1 leads and have scaled webinars with $125 leads , don't get distracted by reducing cost per lead. 
same thing with outbound clickthru rate CPM and cost per click , an amateur ad buyer will see a Webbie funnel campaign getting 6% click-through rate 10-cent cost per click $37 CPM and think it's a good thing. but it's not a good thing , this is a woman in the red dress. it will distract you leaving your attention to solve what u think the problem is , failing to recognize what needs to be done instead. which I somehow hit the character tweet limit so I don'

😂是我对不起大家，之前说 11月11日 上线的，结果硬生生的拖了 5天，就在刚刚终于把测试版打包完成了，做这款游戏真的是没了小半条命，很多小伙伴知道我一直喜欢玩 TD 类的游戏，一直就想自己做一款，结果我太高看我自己看了，也太高看 AI 了。

这款 西游X 我先是交个 Grok Bot 做的，结果做的那叫一塌糊涂啊，每天的高血压八成都是来自于这里，然后转交给 ChatGPT ，全程都是 GPT6 - Astra - Ultra 版本，每天就是 500 美元的 Ultra 版本一周的额度，我存了三个额度都共贡献出来了。

结果 GPT 也是一堆问题，但确实把 Grok Bot 的一堆错乱修好了，但距离上线的标准还是有挺长的一段路，我几乎都要放弃了，这时候 Fable 5.2 出来了，很多小伙伴都说 Fable 5.2 做游戏不错，我就又把所有的工程转移到了 Claude ，全程都是 Fable 5.2 + 超高，终于烧出来了一个交付版。

真的是要了亲命了，最后我再让 Claude 跑一遍应该没什么大问题了，11月17日就可以上线了，这款游戏主要就是将一些小伙伴作为特殊角色加入了游戏中，这可能是唯一好玩的地方吧 😂😂，日后如果有小伙伴愿意，我会继续加入，有正派有反派。

PS：最近我看到有很多小伙伴私信催我问游戏什么时候完成，开始我还以为真的是对游戏有兴趣，后来发现是有人发了同名的 Meme 并且还找了不少角度，我先声明这和我个人以及西游X没有任何的关系。

西游X 也不是链游，就是单纯的单机游戏，后期版本最多是我个人会投放一些奖励，完全没有发币的打算，所有打着我或者这款游戏旗号的发币，我都不建议参与，如果有损失，我个人概不负责。

如果是真的喜欢这款游戏，我非常感谢，这款游戏我也会开源，如果只是为了借名头发币，我是非常不建议的。

text:
NEW: @0xdoug disputes headlines surrounding the $25M Ethereum MEV case, arguing that the ruling was about fraud standards, not whether crypto markets are regulated.

He points to the Supreme Court's Ciminelli precedent, saying bait transactions and invalid block headers did not constitute material misrepresentations.

Doug argues that Byzantine behavior already anticipated and penalized by a blockchain protocol, such as slashing, may not qualify as federal fraud.
author: TTT_News_
quoted_text:
Extremely misleading headline. At no point in the ruling was the word “unregulated” used at all. 

As predicted two years ago, this case would fall apart because SCOTUS drastically tightened the standards for federal fraud statutes in Ciminelli. And it was clear this case would not meet it. 

The crux of the issue is that in times past, federal fraud basically covered anything that was generally shady. SCOTUS recently recognized that as giving the government way too much sweeping power, and restricted fraud to very clear standards.

The judge in this case correctly recognized that “oh you send a transaction you knew would bait others” or “you signed a block header with bad roots” are not clear misrepresentations, because they’re not even representations at all. They’re just computer code.

One specific reading of this ruling is that any sort of Byzantine behavior in a Byzantine fault tolerant protocol is probably not legally fraudulent. The government argued that low carb crusader published a bad block and that was fraudulent. 

The judge ruled that couldn’t be fradulent because the Ethereum protocol had specific rules to handle this behavior (slashing) and it was part of the protocol design. 

The upshot is that most any behavior within the specification of a protocol is probably not fradulent under this standard. Exploits that are explicitly not anticipated (eg exploiting a cryptography bug) are probably fraudulent. But if there’s some misbehavior that’s already modeled and penalized, eg slashing for equivocation, then this case laws says it’s fair game

REDUCE THE ATTACK SURFACE NOW:
The biggest mistake a security engineer can do is to secure a piece of the attack surface that should not exist in the beginning.

Yesterday, hundreds of websites (Zoom, BBC, CNN, Ledger, HSBC, etc.) were hacked through a third party tool  (Optimizely) they all had installed in their websites. This allowed the attacker to inject malware into scripts used by these sites . The trusted CDN served a crypto wallet swapper, card skimmer, cookie/screenshot stealer, and iOS exploit kits. Most cleaned within hours.

Remove unnecesary stuff. The more things you add, the easier it will be to hack you. Most websites just need plain vanilla HTML, stop over engineering stuff.

text:
$DACITY vs $DACITYCOIN

there's a crypto in gta 6 called dacitycoin.

2 of them matter:

> $dacity launched oct 11, minutes after a gameplay leak
> $dacitycoin launched oct 15, 20 minutes after the official trailer showed a plane with "dacitycoin" written on it

for a month, the first one won. it went above $15m. the second one mostly stayed under $2m.

then on nov 10, rockstar posted the pre-load video. there's a helmet in it that says "$dacitycoin".

the next day they flipped:

> $dacity: $7.0m → $1.5m
> $dacitycoin: $2.3m → $6.9m

today:

> $dacitycoin: $5.7m mcap, $548k liquidity, +50% in 24h
> $dacity: $1.4m mcap, $247k liquidity, -23% in 24h

the kols moved with it. on nov 16 at 22:29, @rasmr_eth sold 25m $dacity for $52.5k. within 4 minutes it had bought $50k of $dacitycoin. the biggest $dacity holder bought some $dacitycoin that same night.

$dacitycoin:
> @orangie: 2.94% of the supply, ~$170k. that wallet first sold all its $dacity at a $46.6k loss
> rasmr: 1%, ~$58k. sold its $dacity at a $22.4k loss
> RC: 1.93%, ~$111k. one buy, for $349, right at launch. never sold
> euris, versant, blixze: $40-60k each

$dacity:
> b the bezel: 2.36%, ~$34k. the biggest name still in
> euris again. euris holds both
> a few mid-size traders, and that's about it

named wallets on $dacitycoin hold ~$770k. on $dacity, ~$120k.

so is it over? not yet.

both names are already in rockstar's own material. the leak says "dacity coin", the trailer says "dacitycoin". what nobody has seen yet is the ticker.

gta v had its own stock markets with short tickers. if gta 6 lists this coin as something like dac or dcc, neither of these two wins. the money goes to whatever coin has that ticker, or to the new ones launched within minutes.

what to check on nov 19:

> the in-game stock or crypto app: the exact name and ticker
> the audacity website on the in-game internet: who issues the coin, what the logo looks like
> lucia's parachute mission: does the dialogue say "dacity coin" or "dacitycoin"
> whether the story treats it as a scam

and two things to keep in mind:

> both deployers launch tokens in bulk and sold right after launch. @bubblemaps shows 7-9% of each supply in bundles
> on nov 10, $dacitycoin went from $1.0m to $1.7m in the 2 minutes before rockstar posted the video.

"You have an idea. How do you turn that into a trade?"

That's the question TrueNorth is built around. Kevin's recap of our Drops episode 👇
author: KevinWSHPod
quoted_text:
Inside the Rise of Agentic Trading: Can AI Make You a Better Investor?

In this episode of Drops, I sit down with Willie and Alex, the co-founders of True North, an AI-powered trading platform, to explore why everyday traders struggle to make money, how artificial intelligence could change the way we invest, and why the next generation of financial platforms might look nothing like today's brokerages.
From their unlikely partnership to the challenges of building trust in autonomous financial systems, our conversation explores a future where sophisticated trading tools become accessible to anyone with an investment idea.

Two Different Journeys, One Shared Vision

Willie had built and sold a software company and worked in cryptocurrency exchanges, including serving as an acting CEO, while Alex brought experience in artificial intelligence and institutional investing, having built AI businesses and worked at Temasek.

Despite those differences, they shared similar experiences. They were both Taiwanese, had studied in the West, spent significant time in Asia, and began their careers during China's technology boom. They initially discussed potential investment opportunities when their paths crossed in 2022, but the turmoil after FTX’s collapse disrupted those plans, and they lost touch.

When they reconnected in early 2024, AI was advancing rapidly, and they both recognized an opportunity to apply it to a problem they understood well: trading remained extraordinarily difficult for ordinary people. They began exploring whether AI agents could bridge the gap between having an investment idea and executing it intelligently, and that question eventually became the foundation of True North.

Why Most Everyday Traders Struggle

Financial markets have become more accessible than ever. Anyone with a smartphone can purchase stocks, trade cryptocurrencies, or participate in markets previously dominated by financial institutions. But access doesn't necessarily translate into success.
Professional traders benefit from sophisticated infrastructure, extensive information, disciplined risk management, and years of experience, while retail traders often operate with limited knowledge, emotional decision-making, and little understanding of the risks they're taking.

Alex points out that most individuals rarely examine their trading mistakes. They don't maintain trading journals, reflect on failed decisions, or consistently manage their exposure. Instead, they chase market momentum, react emotionally to volatility, and repeat behaviors that previously cost them money.

On the other hand, professional traders develop strategies, understand market cycles, control risk, and evaluate their decisions systematically. For Willie and Alex, the opportunity isn't necessarily to help everyone discover the next winning investment, but to make the practices of professional traders accessible to people who lack the time, resources, or expertise to develop them independently.

Turning an Investment Idea Into a Trade

The founders summarize the potential of AI in investing with one question: "You have an idea. How do you turn that into a trade?"
Unlike a conventional chatbot that simply answers questions, an AI trading agent can help research opportunities, construct investment strategies, monitor market conditions, and execute predefined instructions.

The founders describe two approaches: copilot and autopilot.

In copilot mode, AI assists with research, planning, and recommendations while the investor remains actively involved, while Autopilot introduces greater automation, allowing agents to manage certain activities within established rules.
However, the goal isn't to eliminate human judgment. AI cannot simply manufacture an investment advantage unavailable to everyone else, but it can help investors capture broader market opportunities more effectively through better timing, position sizing, and risk management.

What If AI Could Learn From Your Mistakes?

One of True North's most interesting capabilities is its approach to understanding individual trading behavior. The platform records what the founders call trader traces: information about users' investment decisions, preferences, reasoning, and historical performance. Over time, these records create a personalized picture of how someone trades.

If an investor repeatedly takes excessive risks during volatile markets, the AI could identify that pattern and flag similar decisions before they're repeated. It could also recognize successful strategies, suggest appropriate adjustments, and help users understand which trading styles suit their goals. Essentially, it becomes an intelligent trading journal that doesn't simply record the past but actively learns from it.

The project already reports approximately 13,000 users and 55% retention over 30 days. According to the founders, users who interact with the platform's AI are also 2.3 times more likely to enter a trade than those who don't. More than the metrics, the more meaningful measure is that people will likely develop better trading habits, stronger judgment, and greater discipline.

Why the Next Generation of Trading Could Move On-Chain

The founders also believe AI agents will fundamentally change where financial activity happens. Traditional brokerages have evolved from providing market access through desktop platforms to offering mobile applications, lower fees, and increasingly diverse financial products. True North sees AI-powered brokerages as the next evolution: platforms that construct personalized portfolios around individual goals instead of offering standardized investment products.

The founders also believe blockchain infrastructure will be particularly important because it enables programmable transactions, self-custody, and verifiable activity.
In principle, investors could retain control of their assets while allowing agents to interact with financial protocols according to predefined risk limits. Transactions could also be independently verified, offering greater transparency into how investment decisions are executed.

Trust Matters More Than Intelligence

Perhaps the most revealing moment comes from a story about the founders' drive to the interview. They activated their Tesla's aggressive "Mad Max" self-driving mode because they were running late, and, initially, they watched every maneuver carefully. But as the journey progressed, they became more comfortable with the system.

They see a parallel with autonomous trading.

People may eventually trust AI agents to handle increasingly complicated financial decisions, but that confidence must develop through experience, transparency, and consistent performance.
Willie captures the challenge in one line: "Money moves at the speed of trust."

Ultimately, True North's broader vision is to create a future where people express their financial goals in ordinary language and use AI to handle much of the complexity involved in pursuing them.

👉If you enjoyed reading the summary, head over to When Shift Happens on YouTube or your favorite podcast platform to access the full convo.

text:
我對於熊市這樣的荒蕪感並不陌生，入圈第九年，也是第三次遇到了這一場景

2017 年的 ICO 之亂，什麼都不懂，入金的錢一個月賺了 10 倍然後 -90% 。年輕時期的不甘心讓我找到了自己的志向，也讓我開始對整個產業懷抱著非常大的熱情以及好奇，甚至當時根本就沒有認為這是「一個產業」

只是感覺到了一個新科技的出現，便一股腦地開始研究

2021 年的疫情災難，才是真的讓人感覺到整個產業有機會消失的時刻：

- 大盤在 24 小時內暴跌超過 40% 至 50%
- MakerDAO 差一點資不抵債進而破產
- 以太幣跌到最低 80 美元

我當時在 FTX 的倉位也爆倉歸零了
現在的恐慌跟當時相比根本是九牛一毛 😂

當時我正好在醫院陪著家人，慘淡的畫面至今歷歷在目。也是在這時候我告訴自己，沒有必要再花那麼多時間在合約交易上，當個長期主義者，顯然是我比較能夠感到舒服的角色和身份

之後，大家意想不到的 SocialFi、銘文等曾經風靡一時的火熱敘事接連出現在市場。能夠在這些敘事上賺到錢的人，他們都有一個共同點：那就是不完全離開市場。

因為一旦完全離開市場、跟幣圈斷了聯繫，想要再回來並第一時間掌握市場上所有的熱點，基本上是很難的

時間快轉到 2025 年 10 月 11 號以及今年幾週前的駭客事件，基本上都算是非常大級別的交易所災難，導致了市場上情緒極度恐慌、流動性撤退等危機，雖然也有 Hyperliquid 這樣子熊市中依然能夠有亮眼表現的新星

但人們開始認為，就連 BTC 也沒有必要 Buy and Hold，畢竟連處於 SuperCycle 的 AI 股票都能夠在一個月內腰斬，風險資產又怎麼能夠抵抗這樣的大環境衝擊？

不過很顯然，這兩年已經不會有「區塊鏈產業會消失了」的聲音出現

儘管加密市場上的團隊正以肉眼可見的速度減少，但單以金融以及科技這兩個關鍵字來看，區塊鏈的影子從來沒有消失，反而更加融入了這兩個領域

金融機構幾乎沒有不探索 RWA 機會的，支付巨頭也都在入局 agentic payment 的相關基礎設施跟標準

熊市不是不前進的藉口，我們有的是時間可以探索如何跟「幣圈外的世界」產生連結，打造產品，學習如何分發，理解原先體制內的人是如何思考的

確實幣圈原生玩家的機會變少很多，但藉由強勁的適應力去學習，也還是能在下個週期取得好成果

text:
关于PREDICT应不应该套保？分享下我的看法

先从结论来说的话，我个人是不会套保，也不会选择退款打新的BNB

主要有几个理由

1️⃣ 最新的TGE日期还不确定，套保空单不知道要扛多久

官方公告只说延后2 ~ 4周，但没有说到时候一定空投

2️⃣ 套保占用了一笔资金

要利用合约做空套保的话，那就必须得放一笔保证金进去，相当于这笔资金就被卡住了没有任何收益

而且还不能够放得太少，不然万一项目方不做人了，跟MMT一样拉盘收割的话，到时候反而得不偿失😭 

3️⃣ 最怕项目方又改规则或者干脆不发币，结果变成虚空套保

套保的前提是已经预计会拿到多少数量的现货，但假设项目方又临时改规则只解锁一半，更狠的甚至一直拖着不发币的话，那这时候套保仓位就成了虚空套保，相当于做空这个代币

如果到时候币价是跌的那还好，但万一涨了那真是平也不是，不平也不是😅 

——————————

说起来币安一开始就不应该允许项目方随意更改TGE日期，而且没有任何惩罚，一旦开了这个糟糕的先例，之后很多项目都照做的话，那还有什么信用可言

10月底第一次延期是因为币安被黑客攻击，属于不可抗力的因素，大多数人对于延期也是能够接受的

不过今天第二次延期就完全是因为项目方自己本身的问题，责任全在项目方身上

而且今天可以因为市场行情不好而延后，下次就可以因为其他理由而延后

🔸 现在行情还没达到我们的预期，所以延后

🔸 因为盘前币价太低了，所以延后

🔸 因为我们要玩预测市场的内幕盘，所以延后

🔸 因为我们钱用光失败了，所以不发币了

这种做法就相当于潘朵拉的盒子，只要开了一次先例，往后只会后患无穷

现在的情况是一般用户对于这种项目方临时更改规则的情况是一点办法也没有。就像之前的Reveel也是利用PreTGE募集资金，结果拿了钱之后就装死跑路了

希望币安能够在项目方身上加上条款「如果要临时更改规则，必须要有某种形式的惩罚」

不然我们这些一般用户拿着BNB去参与打新，结果却落得资金无限锁仓还没有任何补偿的下场，只会慢慢失去对打新项目以及交易所的信任🥹

quoted_text:
我有很强烈的感觉，币圈下一个爆发的赛道是 TCG 卡牌上链

上个周期爆发的赛道是预测市场 & 代币化股票，代币化股票属于 RWA，RWA 的意思就是把现实世界的资产搬到链上来交易。

这两年的 RWA 项目很多，有人尝试把房地产搬到链上来交易，有人尝试把红酒搬到链上来交易，但玩到最后我们会发现，这些方向其实都很鸡肋，有点脱裤子放屁的感觉。

因为不是每种资产都适合搬到链上来交易的。

RWA 目前已经成功的案例有稳定币、代币化美股和债券等等这几个，它们都有几个共同的特性：

• 现实世界中本来就存在大量的交易需求。
• 资产足够标准化，这一份和那一份没有区别。
• 鉴定 & 确权的成本足够低。
• 传统交易方式有局限性，而上链恰好解决了这些局限。

我觉得 TCG 卡牌刚好具备这 4 个特性。

TCG 卡牌尤其是宝可梦系列，本来就存在大量的交易需求，体量至少比目前的 NFT 市场要大得多。

而且 TCG 卡牌的价值共识是经过时间历练的，光是宝可梦系列的 TCG 卡牌就有 30 多年的历史，比特币也就 17 年。论共识，TCG 卡牌可能还是比不过比特币，但是要是拿去跟一些山寨币比，或者跟一些 NFT 小图片比，那完全是绰绰有余的。

再来就是，TCG 卡牌本身有很完善的评级体系。一张卡牌经过 PSA 这样的评级公司鉴定之后，就可以实现资产的标准化，也就是说，两张同样的卡牌，只要都被评为 PSA 10，那「这一张」和「那一张」就没有本质区别，市场也会给予它们同样的定价。

最重要的是，TCG 卡牌的传统交易方式是真的很麻烦，流动性也很差，大部分人都是在线下面对面交易，有一部分人是通过闲鱼或 eBay 这种线上二手平台交易，又慢又麻烦，有些平台甚至还要抽手续费。

所以，币圈去做「TCG 卡牌上链 + 交易平台」这件事情，

其实会是两个圈子双向奔赴的事情。

TCG 圈子需要币圈进来，解决流动性和交易便利性的问题。币圈也迫切需要 TCG 卡牌这种经过时间历练、交易体量足够大的圈子，来进一步去推动 Crypto 的 Mass Adoption。

双向奔赴的好处是，币圈去做这件事不会是一个人在唱独角戏，这个飞轮一旦转起来了，两个圈子的人都会一起积极去推动它前进。我们回看以前的很多的 RWA 项目，其实很多都是币圈在单方面唱独角戏，传统行业的人根本懒得管你币圈在干什么东西。

目前在做 TCG 这个赛道的项目很多，比较主流的有：

BNBChain 上的 @renaissxyz
Solana 上的 @Collector_Crypt 和 @phygitals
Polygon 上的 @Courtyard_io

我自己个人比较看好 Renaiss，

@yzilabs 已经投了他们，我觉得 Renaiss 应该是继 @Aster_DEX 和 @predictdotfun 之后，下一个有机会直接接入币安体系的基础设施，光是这一点，Renaiss 的想象空间就很大了。

如果你也玩 TCG 卡牌的话、可以看看 Renaiss 这个项目，了解一下，可以开几个包玩一玩，也可以当作是一个流动性更好的买卖卡渠道，他们还没发币，顺便做个交互，可以博个空投预期。

text:
Indian law enforcement froze $3M from an innocent Chinese investor after mistaking a crypto bridge for a pig butchering scam. Now an Indian court has ordered Gate to hand his funds to a person they never belonged to.

My analysis of how Indian LE traced through an unlabeled service and wrongly froze @xxxkeym's Gate account:

The case stems from a pig butchering victim who allegedly lost $1.7M of BTC, USDT, DOGE & SOL in May 2025.

Andhra Pradesh CID registered it as Cr. No. 10/2025 and filed a charge sheet in March 2026.

In July 2025, xxxkeym had Gate deposit address 17mpajZ6Nq3dG3T6wUhaXxYF4Qy9HJnYx5 frozen after depositing 15 BTC from 3NcBhqK in the following transaction:
885f3afab562251b222363cf12095e864ddb94636674b01f0cdb05997e5a54a0

This is one transaction Indian LE cites in its notice. 3NcBhqK was funded by xxxkeym's own OKX & Binance withdrawals in Jan 2023 and the coins sat dormant for years until the Gate deposit. 

Indian LE never froze his OKX or Binance accounts, the actual source of the 15 BTC, which tells you how flawed their justification is.

Gate froze his entire account, which held roughly $3M at the time and about $1.5M today.

The Indian court order hands all of it to the complainant.

Gate deposit address 17mpajZ also received two deposits for 15 BTC total in 2025 from bc1pkkwqyxn3rm608ryuqg9hyqna0syq4jx5pxkr7pzg8n3usx6tyqfst5u966, which is also controlled by xxxkeym.

Shortly before the deposits to Gate, bc1pkkw was funded in three transactions by bc1quzwkggdf6ly06mrrnnled0qdr57w770k45n5n7 & bc1qtu66zfqxj6pam6e0zunwnggh87f5pjr7vdr5cd.

bc1quzw & bc1qtu66z were reported as alibarbit[.]bit, the same scam named in Indian LE's press release. 

That was a mistake. Both belong to the Merlin Chain bridge, which is unlabeled in most compliance tools. 

xxxkeym is simply a normal Merlin user trading tokens on the L2. This wrong label is the only place the scam touches his transaction history.

Below is the blockchain data showing each Merlin withdrawal by xxxkeym matched to a BTC payout from those addresses, plus screenshots of the bridge activity.

xxxkeym bridged 50 BTC into Merlin on March 28, 2024, over a year before the alleged May 2025 theft. 

His three withdrawals came out of that balance. I found zero onchain connections between xxxkeym and the theft.

Separately on July 15, 2025 xxxkeym had a 7 BTC private key compromise theft which was reported to local police and also SlowMist was engaged. His stolen funds flowed to Wasabi. 

This is embarrassing incompetence by Indian LE, who seem incapable of reviewing basic blockchain data.

Indian LE, the prosecutor and the judge all signed off on this, Gate froze the account, and LE did a full press release about it recently, while the real victim here (the Gate user) hasn't had access to his funds for nearly 16 months.

My hot take is VASPs need to challenge weak jurisdictions like India, Canada, etc due to repeated negligence in criminal cases.
