text:
发现最近很少发表自己对市场行情的看法了。

我的核心观点其实很简单：没必要看空。

回头看上一轮深熊，整个 Web3 生态其实还停留在相对原始的阶段。

那时候大家在撸 Optimism、Starknet、Wormhole，玩 Galxe，刷任务、领积分、等空投。除了 DeFi 之外，整个行业能提供给用户的东西相对有限。很多人参与 Web3，本质上还是在寻找下一个空投、下一个财富密码。

但这一轮熊市，情况已经完全不一样了。

尽管币价跌得让人崩溃（包括我自己也在持续亏损），但链上生态的发展并没有停下来。RWA 开始真正走向市场，现实世界的资产正在被搬到链上；7×24 小时交易美股逐渐成为现实；链上合约、交易基础设施、资产种类和参与方式，也都在不断丰富。

这些东西，三年前我还觉得是泡沫，是遥不可及的概念。但三年后，它们真的一步步走到了我们面前。

如果你现在依然只盯着 K 线看，看到的可能是一个正在衰退的市场。但如果你把视线放到生态本身，就会发现 Web3 正在进入一个全新的阶段。

上一轮，我们更多是在玩生态、做任务、撸空投。

这一轮，我们开始真正交易资产、参与全球市场、寻找更多投资机会。

两轮之间的变化，远比币价涨跌所体现出来的更大。

我也曾对这个行业感到失望。看着市场不断下跌，看着叙事越来越少，看着曾经热闹的生态逐渐冷清，也会怀疑 Web3 到底还有没有未来。

但最近，我反而有种醍醐灌顶的感觉。

Web3 的未来，可能从来不只是发行更多 Token，也不只是围绕加密货币构建一个封闭的金融市场。

它真正有想象力的地方，是成为全球资产交易、流动性流转和投资机会发现的重要入口。

从 Crypto，到美股、RWA，再到未来更多现实世界的资产。当资产、交易、结算和用户逐渐在链上连接起来，Web3 的边界就不再局限于今天我们所理解的加密市场。

所以，没必要因为这一轮行情不好，就轻易看空整个行业。币价可以在熊市，但生态未必在倒退。

写下这些话之前，我也挣扎了很久，我也觉得怎么 Web3 现在一点创新都没有了，可玩性越来越弱，我也有点失望。但是当我拉长时间线看的时候，我突然看懂了。

有时候，市场最悲观的时候，恰恰是行业在悄悄完成下一次进化的时候。

Bullish!

text:
Claude Code 团队约 90% 的代码由 Claude 来写、来审。Addy Osmani 这篇新文章讲的是，到了这个比例，他们怎么让 Agent 拿出证据证明自己改对了。

我觉得最值得抄的有两个做法。

一：是改动碰不到判它的规则。Code Review 读的 REVIEW.md 永远取自主分支，不读 PR 里的版本。新的提交门禁也会先开 observe 模式跑一段，把误拦看清楚了再强制执行。

二：是一份 39 条的可靠性清单，每条都写明从 diff 里怎么识别、背后是哪次事故。Claude 读完 diff 只查触发到的那 3～10 条，谁都不用把历史事故背下来。

想同时跑很多个 Claude，前提是验证这一层足够可靠。这篇把这层当成正经系统来做，挺值得做 Agent 工程的朋友细读。

text:
Over the past week, I’ve been overwhelmed by the love and support of friends, industry colleagues, and people I've never met. Thank you to everyone who has shown kindness to my family and me. It means the world to me.

I came to the United States 53 years ago, and becoming an American citizen is one of the greatest gifts and proudest moments of my life. NVIDIA has been my life’s work. Building it into the company it is today alongside my colleagues has been a privilege and an honor. Nowhere but in America could a company like NVIDIA be possible. I love our country, and I love NVIDIA.

I did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life. I created problems for the Board that I deeply regret. I own my mistakes completely, and I am committed to cooperating with the Board’s independent investigation. 

Since my departure, I’ve seen an outpouring of calls from NVIDIA’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO. Many continue to reach out to me directly as the company navigates complex technology, market, competitive, and geopolitical dynamics. NVIDIA is a once-in-a-generation company. If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.

Thank you again to everyone who has shared their good wishes. I am profoundly humbled by your support. To my family: I love you, and I will spend the rest of my life being worthy of yours.

Jensen

HyperEVM 生态日报｜2026-11-18

01 生态核心数据

Hyperliquid L1（@HyperliquidX）

Chain Fees 约 ~$12.48k（-41.1%）；Chain Revenue 约 ~$12.48k（-41.1%）；App Fees 约 ~$5.50m（-0.3%）；App Revenue 约 ~$2.63m（-3.8%）；DEX 现货量约 ~$323.53m（-30.1%）

02 协议与流动性

nest（@NestExchange） / Elysium（@Enter_Elysium）

nest 称已为 Elysium 带来超过 $2M 流动性；xStocks 池已在 Elysium 上线，早期做市可获互换手续费 APR 与 NEST 奖励。另称在 epoch 翻转前将 NEST 锁入 HYPE Engine（@TheHypeEngine）金库，可分得 390 HYPE（称约 30% ROI）。

HyperLend（@hyperlendx）

本周 App 大更新：授权改为「使用量 +3%」上限、不再无限授权；兑换价格冲击超 2% 预警、超 50% 拦截；健康因子色阶更保守（绿 >3、黄 1.5–3、红 <1.5）；新增 KyberSwap 与 LiquidSwap 自动择优，HyperTrade 已下线故移除；HLP 金库不再接受 USDHL 存款。其引用的周报还称，在 Elysium 部署 Aave V3 的提案已获通过，友好分叉认定扩展至 Elysium 的 Aave V3.7。

Valantis（@ValantisLabs）

与 Guardian 发起 Defender 竞赛，关键发现潜在奖励 $100,000；称 stHYPE Restaking 已覆盖超过 120,000 HYPE，并举例部分 kHYPE 仓位迁往 stHYPE 再质押、用收益对冲借贷成本。

03 用户侧活动与激励

Kinetiq（@Kinetiq_xyz） / Elysium（@Enter_Elysium）

Tesera 称每笔手续费的 30% 用于 $KNTQ 回购，首次回购在 11-20（周五），之后每周一次、从公开钱包执行，购得的 $KNTQ 进入金库。Kinetiq 转发了该说明。

Entropy（@entropyIO）

第七轮加盟徽章已发放；客服改走 Discord。

fomo（@fomo）

称 Anthropic（$ANT）永续上约 99.8% 的资金为多头；NVIDIA 财报前交易者亦偏多。

Hypernova（@HypernovaX）

窗口内多为互动回复；社区侧继续提及交易者兑付已超过 $3M、平均到账不到 6 秒。未见新的官方里程碑稿。

04 基础设施与开发进展

Ripio 接入（@HyperliquidX / @xulian_hl）

官方转发 Ripio：阿根廷比索、巴西雷亚尔的 wARS/USDC 与 wBRL/USDC 登陆现货订单簿，24/7 报价。xulian 称 Ripio Trade 可使拉丁美洲逾 1000 万 用户进入全球市场，接入覆盖永续与现货，并可从本地货币直接进入。转述称这是迄今最深的 CEX 接入：本地稳定币部署在 HyperCore，并嵌入 Ripio 消费端应用及其 crypto-as-a-service。Ripio 称发行、跨链、订单簿与入口已齐，后续还有 wMXN、wCOP、wCLP、wPEN；Ripio Trade beta 当日开放。

Elysium（@Enter_Elysium） / Kinetiq（@Kinetiq_xyz）

原生桥从 Elysium 到 HyperEVM 的时间已缩短至 24 小时；Relay、Enso、Jumper 等可提供即时跨链。称待 Elysium 预编译上线、打通与 Hyperliquid 的连接后，时间将进一步缩至数分钟。blocktronics 已接入，用于追踪 Elysium 上的代币指标。

https://t.co/c57xZNHCyV（@tradexyz）

11-17 09:00 ET（14:00 UTC）将部分市场的标记价格夹具从每次更新 50 bps 提高至 100 bps，与已实施的 xyz:NVDA 一致。

https://t.co/WAccNp0xrj（@tread_fi）

预告即将上线 RFQ，首个对接为 Silhouette，供 Hyperliquid 交易者询价；VWAP/TWAP 等算法引擎将在价格更优时走 RFQ 成交。

05 新市场与交易资产

现货与 HIP-3

wARS、wBRL 已上线（见第 04 节）。现货代码 $WCLP 以 557.53 HYPE（约 $38,831）拍得（与 Ripio 规划中的 wCLP 是否为同一资产，窗口内未由官方直接确认）。

https://t.co/c57xZNHCyV（@tradexyz）以 584.41 HYPE（约 $40,922）拍得 $SNOW 代码。

Entropy（@entropyIO）上线 Intel（$INTC），最高杠杆 15x。另称 $SNDK 将于 11-20（周五）实施 1 拆 8，其 $SNDK 市场将于 11-19（周四）按拆股后基准结算并重新开盘。

HIP-4 / Outcome（@Outcomexyz） / Proof（@ProofMarkets）
HIP-4 累计成交已超过 $700M。Outcome 转发的研究称：109 个在运行价格合约中有 108 个以 Hyperliquid 永续价格结算；过去一个月交易这些合约的钱包里有 64% 也交易了永续；体育仍占 HIP-4 成交的 87%。
Proof 在财报前推出条件市场，可分别交易 NVIDIA 业绩超预期与不及预期两种情形下的 $NVDA。

Synapse（@SynapseProtocol） / Elysium（@Enter_Elysium）

Hypercall 上线黄金期权：看涨、看跌与多腿策略，规模可低至 $1，24/7 交易。
BounceTech 的 NVDA3L 已在 Elysium 上线：3 倍 NVIDIA 敞口以代币持有，称无保证金、无清算。

NVIDIA 财报（Liquid @liquidtrading / Paragon @tradeparagon 等）

11-17 美股盘后公布财年 2027 第三季度：营收 $115.8B（预期约 $109.33B），同比增长 103%；数据中心营收 $107.6B（预期约 $101.87B）；调整后毛利率 74.9%。第四季度展望营收 $130.0B（±3%，指引不含中国数据中心计算收入）；财年 2028 营收增速上调至约 75%。董事会批准增加 $1500 亿 回购额度。Liquid 称业绩超预期后 $NVDA 上涨，纳斯达克较盘中低点回升约 4%。电话会上称董事会不打算让黄仁勋回归 CEO，并继续物色继任者；同时称不再向中国出货需许可的产品，云产业积压订单约 $2.5 万亿（三个月前约 $2 万亿）。

Anthropic IPO（Kinetiq Markets @Markets_xyz / Liquid @liquidtrading）

修订版 S-1 未上调规模、未改条款。称定价可能高于每股 $78、接近区间上沿；Markets 称盘前约 $98（其另有约 $1.4T 估值表述），Liquid 上隐含估值约 $1.7T。计划 11-18（周三）定价、11-19（周四）开始交易，$ANT 已可 24/7 交易。

text:
我又想了一下，如果拿来部署 @Kimi_Moonshot  Kimi K3 呢？

Kimi K3目前国内API官方定价是每百万输入Token 20 元、输出Token 100 元。

假设同样按官网五折销售，采用7K输入 / 2K输出、没有缓存命中的业务比例，综合收入约为每百万Token18.9元。

以64卡超节点计算，按照PPT的资源使用时间和利用率假设，每月只需要销售约357亿 Token，就能达到约67.4万元的裸金属租金收入目标。

折算下来，平均每卡需要约462 tokens/s的总吞吐。

考虑到K3是一个2.8T参数的大模型，显然不能直接套用 GLM的吞吐成绩，8卡单机也放不下完整的低比特量化权重。

我简单做了个敏感性测算：
假设K3在64卡集群上的单位卡吞吐只能达到GLM 5.2 的20%，按上述价格销售，硬件投入现金回本大约需要 34 个月。
如果只有GLM 的10%，回本周期就会拉长到77个月。

text:
Thoughts on pqai, Hegota, and FOCIL

tldr: Let’s accelerate pqai without rushing or stopping everything else. We can parallelise workstreams to keep shipping EIPs that are ready while the cryptography, designs, and specs for PQ are being worked on and finalised.

We need to accelerate Ethereum’s transition to post-quantum, post-AI cryptography. Let’s take this as a given.

There are two ways to think about what we need to do to enable this acceleration.

1) We deprioritise everything that is not pqai critical. That means all the features we were planning to ship have to wait until after we switch to hash-based cryptography across all layers of the protocol.

To me, the downside of this approach is that we put all our eggs in one basket: if we end up taking 3 years to ship pqai, then Ethereum doesn’t move, at all, for 3 years. That’s “full sequential” mode, and it doesn’t account for important parameters, including how ready features are and what skillsets we have among researchers and client teams (e.g., not everyone is a PQ expert). The only case in which this is inevitable is if we find out that there is an actual break in our cryptography. In that case, I would argue we should be ready to make choices that go far beyond pq2027 ones, and have a concrete plan for what we need to do if we have to ship a minimal, ugly, emergency fork in a couple of weeks.

2) We parallelise. We keep working on the core, minimal features that were already SFI’d by core devs and the community, while accelerating our transition to pqai.

To me, this second approach makes sense when you look at where the forks are:

- Glamsterdam is delayed: most of the work is reaching out and making sure smart contracts don’t break because of repricing EIPs.

- Hegota is in its devnet phase and can keep progressing with FOCIL and Frames in the meantime. Some core devs in all client teams have already worked on these features, they are specced, and now it comes down to “making it work” on the implementation side.

- Importantly, the major PQ/AI upgrades are not yet ready: the specs and the cryptography are not frozen (https://t.co/aGikvd49Kf). On the CL side, we don’t even know exactly what we mean by “PQ consensus” yet. Is it PQ Gasper? PQ Decoupled Consensus? With or without aggregation (and leanVM)? We need a lot more eyes on it, but it’s not realistic to think that all core devs across all teams would be able to chime in and accelerate progress there. Process-wise, I think it’s also important not to DFI features before we even know what we are going for. For example, we will realistically need more time to ship PQ DC than PQ Gasper, and we should ideally settle on which option to go for before making decisions about Hegota.

In other words, the scenario I want to avoid is people DFI’ing features like FOCIL (and others) to get a false sense of security (“we deleted features, so surely we can go faster”), when the reality is more complex and nuanced. I also think these decisions hurt ACD’s credibility, and that we need a strong ACD the ecosystem can rely on, especially during times of uncertainty.

Zooming in

- On the EL, my opinion is that we need Frames for PQ (the only nuances are about how “light” Frames should be). In practice, we could also take the ugly/sequential approach there and ship another transaction type. But given the readiness of Frames, what they would unlock in Hegota and in the future (plus the fact that they’re already SFI’d, of course), there is no reason to settle for a hacky alternative.

- On the CL, we can apply the same type of thinking. For FOCIL, I think the most reasonable path is to derisk it as much as possible so we ensure it is (1) forward compatible with PQ, and (2) minimal enough that it doesn’t delay Hegota and/or take up too many resources from nodes (bandwidth/compute) at a time when we need those for PQ.

FOCIL in Hegota

The good news is that FOCIL is well suited for this, because of two core properties:

- Extensibility: We can fine-tune FOCIL to determine its transaction coverage. I think of it in terms of tiers: if we just want to cover regular/legacy transactions, we get FOCIL in its minimal form (lowest complexity, lowest node resource consumption). On the other hand, if we want FOCIL to cover all types of Frame transactions now and in the future, FOCIL becomes more complex and consumes more resources. In between, FOCIL can cover a limited set of Frame transactions.

- Boundedness: Inclusion lists are amongst the easiest objects to deal with in the protocol. They’re bounded in terms of both size (8 kB) and gas limit (MAX_VERIFY_GAS_PER_IL). We can also cap the gas and size per IL transaction. Inclusion lists are also ephemeral and only useful for the duration of 1 slot, after which they can be forgotten about. And they never go onchain, so they don’t grow Ethereum’s state, which is one of our scarcest resources.

For Hegota, I think FOCIL should sit in between and support a limited set of Frames with clear bounds on inclusion lists. A good approach for shipping FOCIL and Frames in general on devnets is to start with minimal FOCIL, make sure it’s ready, and then extend its transaction coverage gradually. This is a good way to guarantee we can ship FOCIL and Frames as soon as Frames are ready to go.

PQ FOCIL

“PQ FOCIL” can mean two different things, and we should differentiate them.

The first is inclusion lists being able to cover PQ transactions. Here, the simple answer is that FOCIL, without any changes, would be able to include PQ transactions using leanSPHINCS signatures. But it would be able to include a lot fewer: a leanSPHINCS signature is around 5-7 kB and an IL is capped at 8 kB, so probably just 1 PQ transaction per IL, which means up to 16 PQ txns per block (because there are 16 includers, each of them building 1 IL per block). I think that’s fine and good enough for Hegota.

Later, we will probably want FOCIL to cover PQ proofs as well, and for that we will need changes to FOCIL so each IL can include an 8288 proof (around 300 kB). The good news is that by then, we will need the machinery to handle these big recursive proofs being propagated on the network anyway. These are I*/J* considerations, but we should plan ahead and make sure the CL has the capacity to handle bigger ILs down the road.

The second is inclusion lists being PQ/AI resistant. This one is easy: just replace IL BLS signatures with leanXMSS signatures, which would increase their size by 2.4 kB (each IL becoming 10.4 kB instead of 8 kB). But it also raises an interesting question: how important is it for ILs to be signed with PQ sigs? What is the worst attack that could happen if an adversary forged an IL signature?

The worst an adversary can do with forged IL signatures is make every includer look like an equivocator. Nodes ignore ILs from an includer who signed two different lists, so forging a second IL for each of the 16 includers switches FOCIL off for that slot. So the worst thing that can happen is that FOCIL gets neutralised, which is of course far from ideal but a lot less concerning than consensus breaking or funds being stolen. Keep in mind that the adversary would also have to spend significant resources to break the keys of all 16 includers, who are only known a few minutes in advance. An adversary could also publish ILs on behalf of offline includers, but an IL can only force in transactions that are valid and fit in the block, which is what any includer can already do. And the extra load is bounded, because nodes forward at most two ILs per includer.

So even though I think we should generally switch to PQ sigs across all layers of the protocol, this one is definitely not the most urgent or worrying. ILs could potentially keep BLS signatures in Hegota and move to PQ signatures with the rest of the CL.

Closing thoughts

I agree we should accelerate pqai, and prioritise every upgrade that is ready (PQ registration, leanSPHINCS). But DFI’ing everything else won’t make the parts that aren’t ready arrive any sooner. It only guarantees that Ethereum ships no user-facing features while we wait.

PS: I want to be clear that I’m incredibly excited about the future of Ethereum. Thinking about PQ and ZK made me realise that we could completely rethink Ethereum as a cryptographic world computer, and accelerating towards this vision is very bullish. We just need to be careful not to sacrifice its other properties along the way (e.g., credible neutrality, privacy), and we have a very bright future ahead of us.
author: 0x9212ce55
quoted_text:
I agree there are some nuances but I still think the pqai2027 timeline doesn't make a lot of sense

for points that could be more grounded, we need to think about:
- what to settle on from the cryptography side (specific signature schemes for leanSPHINCS and XMSS on the EL and the CL, leanVM specifics and what it means to FV a project of that size and complexity, choosing the hash function)
- how easy we want to be able to switch to something else in case the hash we chose ends up breaking as well
- we also need to differentiate PQ Casper and DC versions with or without aggregation because these involved widely different tradeoffs
- 8288 is not just signature aggregation, it also currently includes leanSPHINCS and leanSTARK (now leaning towards leanPCS, which gives users the possibility to prove any statement and thus the flexibility to chose any signature scheme they like)

Selling Oculus to Facebook in 2014 gave me money for helicopter flight lessons and developing a seastead called SLAB with a 1,000 year design life.

I am only talking about it now because a few media outlets got wind of me and some friends topping up the coffers and plan on calling SLAB my new floating AI datacenter project. text:
a $1.9 million exploit exposed one of the most consequential weaknesses in verifiable computing: a cryptographic system is only as trustworthy as the verifier deciding whether its proofs are valid.

in september, Payy's Ethereum bridge released approximately $1.92 million in USDC after its deployed verifier accepted an invalid withdrawal proof. the technical reconstruction traced the failure to a missing mathematical constraint. one overlooked condition was enough to authorize funds that should never have moved.

this is precisely why @Nockchain's november 16 release deserves attention. the Open Proof Machine is Nock's first full-Nock zkVM, with its end-to-end soundness argument formalized in Lean 4. It covers all twelve Nock opcodes, template jets and big-atom arithmetic, carrying the mathematical argument from Nock's execution semantics through the proof system and into a certified verifier that checks the actual proof bytes. The reported soundness error is approximately 2⁻⁸¹.⁴ under the release's explicitly stated assumptions and query limits. https://t.co/SMoFkS53CH

what makes this especially significant is that Nock isn't treating the VM as an isolated developer feature. its architecture puts STARK proving of NockVM state transitions at the centre of proof-of-work consensus. the same execution environment is intended to support applications that perform computation offchain and submit proofs for verification and settlement onchain.

that creates a much larger design space. AI inference that can be independently verified. financial calculations and settlement that don't require blind trust in an operator. autonomous agents whose actions can be checked against defined rules. cloud and outsourced computation where the provider supplies evidence of correctness, not simply an output and a promise.

the ambition is to give all of these applications a common computational foundation, while making the generation of proofs part of the network's underlying economic activity. that is what makes the Nock architecture so interesting: the VM, the proving system and consensus are designed around the same fundamental primitive.

OPM is an alpha research release, with performance optimization, independent auditing and further development still ahead. But the formal security foundation is now public, reproducible and open to scrutiny. This is a meaningful step toward making verifiable computation native to the network rather than an optional feature layered on top of it.

base:0x9b5e262cf9bb04869ab40b19af91d2dc85761722 isn't just building a place to run applications. it's building the execution and proving foundation through which those applications can establish that their computation was correct.

computation needs proof.

Today I'm launching https://t.co/ENJpTp5ttR Enterprise.

An always-on web research agent team that enables your entire business (analysts, agents, and apps) to move at the speed of AI.

More and more companies are learning the hard way that their agents and chat bots (ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini) are... for lack of a better phrase... making sh*t up when asked to do critical market research and analysis.

Don't get me wrong... They're GREAT at things like coding.

But surprisongly TERRIBLE at research.

In some cases, 30% or more of an agent's web research is hallucinating insights or leaving out, or falsifying, citations.

1. Nothing is double-checking its work so you know which 30% not to trust.
2. Nothing is monitoring the research for changes.

Something better was needed for those whose businesses rely on accurate and timely research they can trust.

DeepSieve's onboarding agent seamlessly works with you or your agent to create a structured research Blueprint (or agent schema) unique to your needs.

Your Blueprint sets the data schema, research guardrails, update frequency, and agent instructions used by your new always-on agent team.

You can then kick off broad-based (or targeted niche) research runs that orchestrate an agent swarm to scour the public web and find you your data.

This is where it gets interesting.

Before the research hits your desk, a second, independent agent team then reviews every bit of the data against its stated citations.

Fixing or informing you about the 30% you wouldn't have known was wrong.

Oh, and then it continuously monitors that dataset so it's always fresh when you need it.

With a full change history, and webhooks to ping you as soon as somethings changed.

The result is an AI-driven research dataset you can actually trust.

And when you can trust it, you can then automate it within your agent and app workflows.

This is why I built https://t.co/ENJpTp5ttR agent-first and app ready (MCP/CLI/API/SDK), so the entire stack becomes a new, pluggable superpower within your existing workflows.

text:
Born like this
Into this
As the chalk faces smile
As Mrs. Death laughs
As the elevators break
As political landscapes dissolve
As the supermarket bag boy holds a college degree
As the oily fish spit out their oily prey
As the sun is masked

We are
Born like this
Into this
Into these carefully mad wars
Into the sight of broken factory windows of emptiness
Into bars where people no longer speak to each other
Into fist fights that end as shootings and knifings

Born into this
Into hospitals which are so expensive that it’s cheaper to die
Into lawyers who charge so much it’s cheaper to plead guilty
Into a country where the jails are full and the madhouses closed
Into a place where the masses elevate fools into rich heroes

Born into this
Walking and living through this
Dying because of this
Muted because of this
Castrated
Debauched
Disinherited

Because of this
Fooled by this
Used by this
Pissed on by this
Made crazy and sick by this
Made violent
Made inhuman
By this

The heart is blackened
The fingers reach for the throat
The gun
The knife
The bomb
The fingers reach toward an unresponsive god

The fingers reach for the bottle
The pill
The powder

We are born into this sorrowful deadliness
We are born into a government 60 years in debt
That soon will be unable to even pay the interest on that debt
And the banks will burn
Money will be useless
There will be open and unpunished murder in the streets
It will be guns and roving mobs
Land will be useless
Food will become a diminishing return
Nuclear power will be taken over by the many
Explosions will continually shake the earth

Radiated robot men will stalk each other
The rich and the chosen will watch from space platforms
Dante’s Inferno will be made to look like a children’s playground

The sun will not be seen and it will always be night
Trees will die
All vegetation will die
Radiated men will eat the flesh of radiated men
The sea will be poisoned
The lakes and rivers will vanish
Rain will be the new gold

The rotting bodies of men and animals will stink in the dark wind

The last few survivors will be overtaken by new and hideous diseases
And the space platforms will be destroyed by attrition
The petering out of supplies
The natural effect of general decay

And there will be the most beautiful silence never heard

Born out of that.

The sun still hidden there
Awaiting the next chapter.

text:
比特币这波砸到 6.2 万美元，到底是不是底？

@glassnode 昨天发布的一份链上周报里的量化数据，或许更能说明目前盘面的真实情况。

数据显示， $BTC 近期下挫不仅是一次常规的杠杆清洗，多项核心指标已经逼近过去几次市场底部的特征区间。以下是几个值得关注的量化数据与结构变化：

1. 投降式卖出与已实现亏损出现极端情况

本轮下跌将链上“已实现亏损（Realized Loss）”推升至过去几个局部底部（如 2018、2020、2022 以及 2023 年初）才会出现的极端水平。
这表明，短期持有者在恐慌情绪驱动下，正在集中交出亏损筹码。

2. 底部防线62K
盘面目前正运行在由 8 月低点形成 6.2 万至 6.6 万美元的密集筹码区。

在近期最剧烈的两个交易日中，这个区间里增持了约 6.6 万枚 BTC，显示出有大额买盘在承接。

潜在风险在于，短期持有者在此区间下方缺乏密集买盘，且堆积了较多多头清算筹码。
若日线级别有效跌破该区间，可能伴随清算压力进一步向下测试 5.85 万美元（6 月低点）以及 5.37 万美元的全网实现价格（Realized Price）。

3.杠杆出清，买盘开始超过卖盘

11 月 13 日至 14 日的下跌引发了自 2023 年以来最大规模的多头清算，价格直接击穿了此前偏薄的流动性空隙，目前大部分高杠杆多头已被清洗。
在 Binance 和 Coinbase 上，现货挂单买盘（Bids）开始超过卖盘（Asks），6 万美元附近出现了自 8 月以来最大的单笔挂单聚集区，表明主买力量在极端行情中开始进场。

比尔·阿克曼在这段采访中阐述了Jensen回归的路径，关键在于Jensen身上的指控：

如果事实证明Jensen的问题只是个人生活上的失误（personal foible），而不是涉及公司层面、国家安全或某种“阴谋”的话，那么让他重新担任英伟达CEO是有充分理由的，甚至可以成为一个很有力的案例。

具体做法他提到：
•  先把事实搞清楚、摆出来；
•  然后召集一次特别股东大会（special meeting）；
•  可以和詹森合作，因为詹森自己持有约3%的股份，这有助于达到召集特别股东大会的门槛；
•  他预计一旦提出这个方案，局势会很快明朗，可能甚至不需要真正开到会，董事会就会直接让他回归，同时对董事会做一些调整，然后继续往前推进。

所以现在Jensen现在能否回归其实很大程度上取决于在自身的调查，如果最后调查只是私德，不涉及国家安全间谍活动的话，便可按照上述路径来执行。自身的3%持仓再联合几个大的资管机构和大的个人投资者，很容易得到15%的比例。

The service is designed to support institutional treasury operations, payment settlements, and liquidity management. Building on their prior participation in the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s (MAS) Project BLOOM, the two firms will also collaborate to advance interoperability across different forms of tokenized money and financial networks.

text:
要说这次英伟达财报有瑕疵除了资本生态外（采购承诺和担保），应该就是毛利率的下降了。尽管下季收入指引强劲，但对第四财季毛利率的展望却相对谨慎。公司预计第四财季GAAP和非GAAP口径的毛利率分别为71%至72%，明显低于第三财季的74.8%和74.9%。
这意味着毛利率可能环比下降约3个百分点。

毛利率承压主要与两方面因素有关：
一是内存价格上涨；
二是新一代Rubin产品处于初期爬坡阶段，相关生产和供应链成本相对较高。
这也意味着增长是有成本的。

需要关注未来Rubin规模化出货后，毛利率能否逐步恢复。
author: qinbafrank
quoted_text:
老黄离开后的英伟达三季度财报看点：本季大超预期下季及下一财年指引很强劲，对外新的投资担保谨慎，董事会明确不打算请回老黄。聊聊个人理解。
1、具体数字很多地方都能看到，只说关键点：
1）Vera Rubin开始正式交货、创造力英伟达历史上最快的爬坡记录，单季交付超过200亿美金，这个量级与公司本季约196亿美元的整体环比收入增量接近，说明新产品是增量来源，且新产品的交付本没有挤压原有产线的销售；

2）下一季指引1300亿美元，达到所有买方卖方的最高预期水平。

3）进一步上调了2028财年增长预期（本季是27财年第三季度），公司目前预计截至2028年1月的2028财年营收同比增长约75%，高于此前提出的70%以上增长目标。今年（2027财年）英伟达的营收应该能超过4200亿美金，那么明年（2028财年）按照75%的增速营收能超过7400亿美金。

4）公司三财季通过回购和分红向股东返还281亿美元。剩余股票回购授权约2273亿美元，要在28年之前完成，意味着未来五个季度单季平均回购450亿美金的股票，回购力度已经达到单季自由现金流的规模。

2、电话会议上临时CEO聊到几个关于产业的信息
1）OpenRouter上的周度Token使用量同比激增35倍，过去三个月内增长了3.5倍。智能体工作负载目前占据约80%的Token量。

自5月以来Token价格已下降近60%，这推动了Token使用量的加速增长和算力需求的扩张。也带动GPU租用价格跨代上涨——已有老一代GPU在多年期合同中以最高两倍的原价续约，而B300的租用费率自推出以来已上涨逾60%。

2）CPO路线快速推进，规模化生产已经启动。Lambda宣布了英伟达光子CPO交换机的首个量产部署，连接逾1万颗GB300 GPU。与公开插拔式光模块方案相比，英伟达光子交换机的能效提升5倍，可靠性提升15倍，延迟降低10%。三季度，英伟达的网络业务收入超过210亿美元。这可能是看到的对上游产业链最利好的一个信息。

3）Vera Rubin Ultra仍按计划于明年发布，Feynman将于2028年推出。
POD到货后即可直接连接部署，将上线时间从数月压缩至数周，大幅加快首次Token生成的时间。对于年收入规模达500亿美元的1吉瓦AI工厂而言，仅仅提前一个季度达到首次Token生成，就可能为运营商额外带来逾100亿美元的收入。

4）云行业积压订单目前已达2.5万亿美元，较三个月前的2万亿美元进一步增长。

3、资本生态
截至第三财季末英伟达的供应承诺从上一财季的2790亿美元增加至3900亿美元，主要与多年期内存采购有关。
此外公司云服务协议和数据中心租赁承诺合计达到1020亿美元，高于上一季度的740亿美元。
如果进一步计入股权投资、资本开支等项目，英伟达披露的未来各项承诺合计达到5180亿美元。

而相关融资担保敞口和Neocloud协议由公司另外列示：
1）披露最高1180亿美元的第三方融资担保敞口。最大的一笔涉及俄亥俄州SB Energy建设的数据中心园区。英伟达提供的相关担保最高达到1050亿美元，项目将建设约4.25吉瓦的数据中心容量，并通过长达20年的租赁安排为OpenAI提供基础设施。

2）公司还披露与新兴云服务商（Neoclouds）的相关承诺达到320亿美元。

关于“英伟达是否准备收缩客户融资”，
Kress在会上发出了明确信号：英伟达在支持新兴云客户时将变得更加“克制和挑剔”。她表示公司正在“严格评估”各项投资、承诺和财务担保。

Kress详细划定了英伟达的担保底线：
如果（数据中心建设）开始了，但不幸的是他们被推迟了，或者在建设方面遇到了挑战，我们的担保就不再存在了。我们对其中大多数项目的担保，实际上是基于它们准备就绪的时候。

我的理解是：原有的仍在继续，但未来项目的筛选应该会更谨慎和严格。英伟达不再为早期的水泥建设或选址买单，只有当数据中心的土地、电力和外壳等基础设施真正就绪时，财务担保才会生效。

这向其实发出一个明确信号：部分企业是时候自力更生了。对于Neocloud来说，27年要为生存而战了。

4、关于老黄回归问题
董事会主席Harvey Jones在电话会明确表示董事会不打算恢复黄仁勋的CEO职务。他透露，董事会目前正同步考察内外部的CEO候选人，并表示“此次遴选将会全面而审慎”，在“找到真正合适的人选”前，公司绝不会仓促推进。

“先进芯片技术和国家安全形势正在改变英伟达的经营环境，而新任 CEO 必须能够妥善应对这些变化。”

虽然昨晚老黄也表态了回归的意愿，但是今年电话会的表态我们也要做好未来老黄不能回归的准备。

5、怎么看这份财报对市场的影响
1）短期内强劲财报和下季下一财年的指引会提振市场的情绪，短期内可能会带动市场一波反弹。

2）但中长期最大的考验还是如果老黄确定不能回归后，新的ceo能不能顶替上来。不然市场还是会对技术迭代的速度，产业生态支持力度心存疑虑。

许多人不知道，加密机构对不同国家或地区的执法协作态度是截然不同的，以大家喜闻乐见的泰达公司Tether为例👇

首先来自美国政府的冻结请求是最高优先级，基本都是有求必应并且协作速度极快，链上执法活动甚至能够先于行政命令。例如前段时间新币担保事件，该实体在被冻结第一批地址后，新启用的地址仅数十小时就被冻结了，这个时间差基本不可能让法院开出冻结令来，我合理推测是一线执法人员跟tether合作搞了一波先斩后奏；

其次是以中国为代表的第三世界国家或地区的执法部门，这种的就是按照正常规章协作，从发函到正式冻结大概1-2周，慢是慢了点，但好歹会正常响应；

最后也是最糟糕的，部分东南亚国家的执法协作。我个人有所体验的是曾服务过的一名缅甸华人客户，对方遭到入室抢劫USDT，他拿着我的报告成功在当地立了案，但当地执法人员给tether发函，直接被冷暴力已读不回😂不过也能理解，毕竟按照泰达自己的官网通稿，他们的协作对象并没有覆盖所有的国家或地区。

回到朝鲜这个话题，我个人没有跟朝鲜执法部门或者朝鲜受害人合作过，没这方面经验，有懂哥的话可以补充一下。
author: lurenbian
quoted_text:
昨天有个哥们提了一个问题，就是朝鲜政府能不能要求加密交易所进行司法冻结？

其实理论上，任何一个主权国家的执法机构，都有权向交易所提出司法协查、资产冻结的请求。

但交易所有并不是都有义务配合。

如果一家交易所在某个国家合规运营，向当地用户提供服务，那它一定要需要遵守当地法律，配合合法有效的司法调查。

但几乎所有的加密交易所根本不向朝鲜用户提供服务，在朝鲜也没有经营实体。

所以在这种情况下，朝鲜法院的裁定通常无法直接约束交易所，管辖权有限。

等于说我并不做你这个市场的生意，你就没办法要求我直接执行你的司法裁定。

假如金三胖签一张司法冻结令有效，那么他们似乎就不需要到处让黑客搞事情了。

quoted_text:
"The Mask Maker" - new 1/1 from the world of Luci

Acquired by The Alan Howard Collection

https://t.co/S24U3RRLir

In the spring of last year, @MrsRachelSpratt and I glanced at the baby monitor and saw our daughter, not even one at the time, throwing up what looked like half her body weight in her crib. We grabbed her, strapped her into the stroller, and sprinted through Manhattan to the nearest pediatric ER while she kept vomiting down the streets of New York.

A hard way to learn about an obscure allergy. They got the EpiPen in, and we held her on the crunch of hospital bed paper while her stomach quieted and her color slowly came back. An hour passed, stable. Another, and she was drinking water. Another and she was giggling like nothing had even happened and largely just amused by the red LED taped to her making her skin glow. And then my phone rang.

To explain that call, you have to spiral backward three months, and then three years.

Right after Masquerade released, I got a text from Benny.

I was spared from the ceremonially annoying "hey" which he waits until answered to get to the point, or something mangled in spelling beyond the english language. It was just: "Do you have any other 1 to 1 supply?"

I didn't.

“Nothing?”

What I had were studies and sketches of the figures inside Masquerade: built the same way I’d drawn character studies for The Monument Game. Stories about feelings had, memories of those feelings, and the people who rhymed with them along the way, all just dormant, waiting to be fleshed out with time.
Thanks to the people who participated in my last two works, Luci is now covered in stories—each a mark, a person who looked and left a piece of themselves on the surface. I love these marks. Beneath the metadata, IPFS pins, and talk of "networked art," though, there is still an artwork made from Millions of small decisions and brushstrokes, and every figure within has a story, and reason for being placed exactly where they are.

He said: “let me see.”

I sent one sketch over: "Who is asking?"

I didn't get an answer for three months.
Not until the ER.

@goldie_mceve  was on the line. Martina and I go back a ways now. Even before Venice, when I first exhibited The Monument Game. For months, it turned out, she had been quietly researching the work and larger body of Luci on behalf of and alongside Alan Howard and his advisory team. Martina, with her very cheery Italian accent that always sounds like she’s smiling says:
 “Hello, Sam, how is Rachel? Is now a good time? I have something I’d like to ask you.”

I looked at Rachel showing Syla the red light passing through the hole of the saltine crackers. 

“Now is great”

She was calling with an offer from Alan.

Out of every figure inside X. Masquerade, in the back-left corner, sitting in the mist of the Kingdom of the Included: there is a hooded man carrying a heavy pack covered in the Masks I had been making for each of you. The labor of performance and toil to imbue what we make with enough to keep the whole thing going.

Sitting in the hospital with my daughter was where this piece shifted out of idea-land, but for a figure to get off the corner of one painting and into a piece of its own was not a phone call and offer. This is not a “brokered by” situation, but rather a funny spiral of chance meetings happening from people creating moments for more, people pulling one moment to the next, and paths converging louder later from the collisions of connection years prior.

Years ago at a Bright Moments and Art Blocks event in Paris, (thank you to @seth and @ArtOnBlockchain  for building your own worlds to bring people together), I bumped into Alan. I didn't know him, but he told me his great love is Impressionism and that almost nothing in all of art since had held him until he fell back in love with art through digital and code-based work. Someone who devotes himself to collecting Monet, skips an entire century, and then waxes poetic on generative art is an oddity if nothing else. An eccentric within an eccentric night. Just a ripple.

Time went on.

In 2024, after the initial rush of the Venice Biennale opening had faded, I was standing at our dock door of the exhibition @kukulabanze  and @scrptdfntsy put on with me. Looking out across the canal, Alan and his wife Caroline pulled up by boat. It was a quiet day at the exhibition and I was able to walk them through all of Luci, Birth to The Muck, and then we sat for an hour in front of The Monument Game while we discussed the very old story that led to all of this. A Skull, a Player, and then some Masks entered his collection since, and that was already a wonderful chain of events. But I think what I’ve discovered is that people often mistake a moment as something able to just be “done”, rather than an opening of a relationship to another moment backwards and forwards in time. A flow.
That same weekend in Paris I had met Alan, I had also met @mickymalka of @Kanbas_ . Months later on that same dock, Micky brought @beckykleiner over. Both of them have become dear friends and nearly a year after led to Masquerade. Masquerade then led to the Toledo Museum of Art and the Infinite Images exhibition. Infinite Images filled with works from Alan’s collection, and suddenly loops were forming and bridges were being built. Benny keeping conversations alive, months of Martina's research, and years of all of you putting your own lives into the work came back around to a hospital room in Manhattan. I’m just staring at the best and only things that truly matter to me, the things I’m all in, my girl with her shining red light held by the rock of Rachel, and get to feel this chain reaction of relationships unfold to get there, all for her. Creation begetting creation.

In the background of making this piece, as well as the broader body of work still to come in the next chapter, I enjoy and will continue to enjoy the quiet time to create and experiment. When I poke my head up, it’s to share a story along the way, then duck back down to work. This poke, I see a newfound cannibalism: whispered and snake-like emerging - an eating of our own, blood-tainted water that is hungry to discard bodies. If you believe this is not the end of history, then it is odd to let a river be treated like it holds the stagnancy and scarcity of a pond. And if you believe it is the end, grace is the last thing to abandon at the gates. Everything still growing here came from movement. Big collisions flowing out into vast expanses. Currents combine, gather in force, carve through the land, and spread. To pathfind. Meandering, though the wander can be, I find it best to build on the bend and watch what floats downstream as nature clears the water with time.

The Mask Maker is the first 1/1 from this world I’m making with no Luci in the frame. The first without a numeral in the chronology. It has no “mechanics”.  But if you’re new here, it has all you need to know for now.

The next chapter from here, is a massive departure from anything I’ve done before. Creating The Mask Maker alongside it, dancing between a life as a painter, the hybridity of new tools slipping in and out of the old, developing my own software while drawing more than I ever have, sitting in the feeling of gathering, performing, dispersing, all has made the work “more”. Making art, especially for long periods of time for projects that will be shared over the course of the next several years, can be an isolating experience, there is no drip of daily connection from a well-fed algorithm.  As many components of what I do become ever-more complex, being rooted in the story of a single figure and feeling in time, the feeling of what it has been like to know each of you, interpret each of you, and open paths to know more than what is presented by each of us - the medium stays in relationships and the stories between us.

My deep thanks to Alan for his conviction and patronage in acquiring The Mask Maker, it means a tremendous amount to join the collection. There’s no room for aloofness in me with this, it’s a lot of trust to place, on a timescale that reaches back to Monument and commitment to a future far from now. 

Thank you to Martina for the friendship and scrutiny, and for passing the torch to Sebastian who has been an incredible voice in bringing it home, to Benny for always trying to stitch it all together, mess that you are, @musicalnetta for holding what I love up in the quiet with 613 days of vigilant ethnography, you live in the piece and I share it today in celebration of you as an opening to your close, and I hope this does not sound placating because I really do mean it: to everyone who has helped give me and The Mask Maker something to feel, even when it’s violent I greatly appreciate these collisions most of all.

For anyone who hasn’t yet added something of themselves, holds someone else’s contributions, or maybe feels what they presented in the past wasn’t quite what they are, my site has just undergone a massive change under the hood, and you may find a good place for the potential of what could be.

text:
AI 时代最能赚钱的或许不是做模型的人！当最前沿的 AI 模型在数月内迅速同质化、推理价格以每年约 13 倍的速度暴跌时，真正持久的超额利润不会留给研发模型的实验室，而会沉淀在智能进入实体经济所必须经过的稀缺、可控且不可绕过的关口——即新时代的“制高点”。

这个词是列宁 1922 年提出来的。Will Manidis 和 Joe Roberts 上个月发的长文《The Commanding Heights》把它搬到了 AI 时代，全篇 145 页就论述了一件事，财富最终归谁 🤔

文章很长，但可读性极好，有很多生动的故事。我根据全文的论述，拆解了五个相互咬合的子模型，给大家搭建一个易于理解的框架。

1. 产业演进的“双阶段分流模型”（Genesis vs. Commanding Heights）文章将技术革命划分为两个截然不同的生态位，解释了为何“造技术的人往往赚不到最后的钱”：

创世纪层（Genesis，价值消耗区）： 由大模型实验室、芯片商和云巨头组成。由于模型本身极易被蒸馏、模仿和开源替代，前沿模型在几个月内就会沦为大宗商品（推理价格每年暴跌约 13 倍）。身处其中的企业陷入“囚徒困境”——个体为了不掉队必须疯狂烧钱扩算力（训练成本每年涨 3.5 倍），但全行业加总却在毁灭资本回报。

制高点层（Commanding Heights，价值捕获区）： 指智能进入真实经济活动所必须穿过的稀缺、垄断性关口。区别于电力、变压器等会被资本扩产填平的“暂时性瓶颈”，真正的制高点具备正向乘数效应——底层 AI 越廉价、越泛滥，流经该关口的交易量就越大，其抽成能力和垄断地位反而越稳固。

2. 宏观金融的“一线绑定模型”（The Line）文章提出了一个解释美国宏观经济运转的闭环模型：AI 资本开支、科技股估值与模型能力提升，三者已被锁死在同一条指数上升曲线上（The Line）。

运转机制： 这条线不仅是科技行业的生命线，更是美国 GDP 增长、家庭股票财富（养老金）和私募信贷扩张的共同底座。

国家托底推论： 因为这条线一旦断裂就会引发系统性金融危机与地缘失利，华盛顿绝不会允许它崩盘。当科技巨头的自由现金流不足以支撑万亿美元级的算力投入、底层资产出现减值时，美国政府必然动用养老金体系乃至财政部信用入场兜底，将其演变为“国家隐性担保的准公共基建”。

3. 地缘政治的“双极双轨模型”（Two Sovereigns, Two Frontiers）在国家博弈层面，文章推演出一个高度对称又路径迥异的双极格局：

主权双极化： 只有美国和中国具备持续迭代前沿模型的算力、电力与资本纵深，世界上其余国家将丧失“技术主权”，沦为智能的纯消费国。

能力双轨化： AI 将分裂为对外开放的“商业前沿”与锁在绝密设施（SCIF）里的“主权前沿”（专供国防、情报与大国博弈，不计现金流回报）。

美国受制于股东回报与养老金市值要求，必须维持高估值与商业变现预期；中国则不受二级市场估值束缚，可以容忍模型公司低估值甚至微利，通过向全球倾销廉价的开源权重模型，瓦解美国商业模型的定价权。

4. 货币循环的“新美元铸币税模型”（The Neo-Dollar Loop）文章构建了一个连接“AI 智能体普及”与“美国国债消化”的跨国金融循环：

需求端爆发： 数十亿全天候自动交易的 AI 智能体无法使用传统银行柜台，将催生对链上美元稳定币（即“新美元”，Neo-Dollar）的无限需求；同时，新兴市场民众为规避本币贬值也会涌入数字美元。

美债隐性买单： 稳定币发行商必须购买短期美债作为储备资产。这意味着全球无数没有美国银行账户的个人与智能体，在不知不觉中成了美债的接盘侠。美国政府得以借此通过温和通胀（货币贬值）稀释巨额债务，而私有稳定币与清算网络的所有者则坐收随通胀水涨船高的交易过路费。

5. 社会与企业的“K 型塌缩模型”（The Firm & K-Shape Society）在微观组织与社会结构层面，文章描绘了一个中间层彻底消失的模型：

企业组织重构（去劳动化）： 延续百年的“股东—经理人—庞大白领雇员”现代公司制走向终结。未来的企业模型将退化并升级为“极少数核心操盘手（按资本合伙制分红）+ 海量无领 AI 模型（No-Collar Labor）”，常规脑力劳动被彻底清出资产负债表。

全球分配撕裂： 过去发展中国家靠承接发达国家后台外包（如印度 IT 与财会服务）实现现代化的阶梯被 AI 斩断，原本发往班加罗尔的工资直接转化为纽约总部的净利润；与此同时，富裕国家收紧移民与职业牌照壁垒（行会化），形成“顶层资本与牌照持有者极度繁荣、底层与外包国面临结构性失业”的极端 K 型世界。

做个不那么乐观的预言，我们将进入一个“技术通缩驱动特权通胀”的未来世界：算力与智能在底层疯狂烧钱并走向免费化，从而在顶层引爆对货币清算轨道、监管牌照、终端分发入口和稀缺物理资产的极致垄断。
